hud33._why: View only (U, D-1): the HUD and the front UI rebuilt (U1 spec): no panel fills, one 20-degree slash motif, text with a 2 px shadow, 64 / 24 / 16 px type, bone-white points, one top-centre message slot, the door hint as a world marker. Unity-only view numbers in UnityTuning.Hud33.cs.

look33._why: View only (L): every light has a visible fixture (no floating light), six fixture types, a neutral-tonemapped post profile, local lava light, dust / embers / haze / sparks. Unity-only view numbers in UnityTuning.Look33.cs.

kit33._why: View and flow (K): the arena kit (K1's 39 elements) and the dressing pass on every level; while on, the campaign plays the dressed n33 files (levelSwap, applied after NIGHT32's swaps in Curriculum25.N33Levels). Decor adds no colliders; cover pieces collide (they are in the n33 level files, so they are on the run's tape as the level id).

arenas33._why: View and flow (R): the overhauled rooms (at least two per level, levels 1-5) live in K's n33 files; this row gates R's own view pieces and reel. The devices are the sim row devices33.

view33._why: View only (W, D-5): LT zoom changes the WORLD FOV only; the gun lowers 4-6 cm and eases in 120 ms, never slides to the centre or rolls; idle sway, speed-scaled bob, a landing dip, a recoil spring per weapon; the rope's hook head, sag and snap. Unity-only view numbers in UnityTuning.*33.cs.

n34._why: NIGHT34 (GG 2026-10-11, after playing n33: the grapple triggers 'a dramatic slow-motion effect with a clear visual overlay' so players 'switch weapons in real time and chain fluid, expressive combos ... as the world bends around you'; remove 'that little diamond indicator'; 'an ULTRAKILL-style weapon display that shows your full arsenal'; the game is 'cluttered with detail for the sake of detail' and 'the arenas don't incentivize creative movement'; the Pulse Gauntlet 'a slightly larger active hitbox when striking bosses like the worm'; movement, UI, responsiveness and flow 'dramatically better'). Every row is off in the shared commit and turned on only when its check passes. Off (--off34 / -skygrindOff34, and every older off switch): NIGHT33's game bit for bit. Unity-only numbers each carry a _why naming their source (NIGHT34.md method 1: reference first). Plan: NIGHT34.md; defaults: DECIDE34.md; research: Research/2026-10-11-wave34/.

bend34._why: Builder B (NIGHT34.md B1): the grapple BEND. Every latch (node, wall, the whip on an enemy) gives a SHORT BEND; a full BEND METER gives the FULL BEND (kills refill it, never time). Inside a bend the weapon swap is instant. split (bendSplit34): the world steps 1 in N while the player steps every step; off: the global path (the whole sim eased, Bend34Share). The web has no slow motion of its own (its killSlowMo is a view effect). Builder B adds its numbers with their _why.
bend34.scale_why: The world's time share inside a bend (global: the loop's share; split: the world steps 1 in round(1 / scale)). RESEARCH.md table B: not found in any game (research/slowmo.md 3); the forge's choice, judged by frames f1-f4. The web has no slow motion of its own (its killSlowMo is a view effect), so it has no such number.
bend34.inS_why: Ease in, real seconds. RESEARCH.md table B (research/slowmo.md 9, 2). Global: whole sim steps at the ramp's mean share (1 + scale) / 2; split: whole player steps. The web has no slow motion of its own (its killSlowMo is a view effect), so it has no such number.
bend34.outS_why: Ease out, real seconds (research/slowmo.md 9: a 0.3 s ramp out; 2024 paper: 0.2-0.4 s reads heavy). Converted as inS. The web has no slow motion of its own (its killSlowMo is a view effect), so it has no such number.
bend34.shortS_why: The SHORT BEND on every latch (node, wall, the whip on an enemy), free, real seconds. RESEARCH.md table B: the red team's finding 13 (GG's 'the whole point' is real-time swaps on the grapple). The grapple's own charges (NIGHT32) are its limit. The web has no slow motion of its own (its killSlowMo is a view effect), so it has no such number.
bend34.holdS_why: The FULL BEND's length, real seconds, paid by a full meter. RESEARCH.md table B: research/slowmo.md 9 (3 s), shortened for small rooms. The web has no slow motion of its own (its killSlowMo is a view effect), so it has no such number.
bend34.killExtendS_why: Each kill inside a FULL bend adds this, real seconds. RESEARCH.md table B: research/slowmo.md 9 (+0.5 s per kill). The web has no slow motion of its own (its killSlowMo is a view effect), so it has no such number.
bend34.maxS_why: A FULL bend's cap, real seconds (in + hold). RESEARCH.md table B: research/slowmo.md 9 (cap 6 s), shortened for small rooms. The web has no slow motion of its own (its killSlowMo is a view effect), so it has no such number.
bend34.refillPerKill_why: The BEND METER (0..1, starts full at every run start; nothing refills it over time) gains this per player kill outside a full bend (kills inside one extend it instead). RESEARCH.md table B: research/slowmo.md 1, 6 (Max Payne 2, Severed Steel); 0.25 is the forge's choice (no source found). The web has no slow motion of its own (its killSlowMo is a view effect), so it has no such number.
bend34.rankDoubleMult_why: A kill at style rank rankDoubleLetter or higher refills x this. RESEARCH.md table B: the forge's choice (no source found). The web has no slow motion of its own (its killSlowMo is a view effect), so it has no such number.
bend34.rankDoubleLetter_why: The style rank letter (config style.ranks, D C B A S SS) from which a kill counts double. RESEARCH.md table B: 'x2 at rank S+', the forge's choice. The web has no slow motion of its own (its killSlowMo is a view effect), so it has no such number.

bendLook._why: View only (builder H, NIGHT34.md H1): the bend's post grade (desaturate toward a cool grey, red-orange and cyan kept by hue, the sky dimmed, a step deeper per kill), the entry FOV thump, the meter's slash. Unity-only view numbers in UnityTuning.Bend34.cs.

rail34._why: View only (builder H): the ARSENAL RAIL bottom right: every owned weapon a slot, the hand larger and cyan with its LT verb, the highlight slides on a swap, a holstered gun turning ready pulses once. Unity-only view numbers in UnityTuning.Hud34.cs.

nomark34._why: View only (builder H): Grapple31View's target diamond is not drawn (GG: 'Remove that little diamond indicator ... it breaks immersion and isn't needed'); the node ring stays.

lines34._why: View and flow (builder A, NIGHT34.md A1): fight rooms rebuilt around movement lines (a wall-run wall, a grapple node and a bhop lane that chain, two or three floors, a climb route per floor), spacings from SKYGRIND's own measured jump / dash / ride / grapple distances. While on, the campaign plays each rebuilt level's n34 file (levelSwap, applied after NIGHT33's swap in Curriculum25.N34Levels; a level not in the map keeps its n33 file).

calm34._why: View only (builder A): dressing props with no collider and no purpose are not placed (at least 40 % fewer per level, counted); cover, climbs, devices and fixtures that light a room stay.
calm34.keepKinds_why: The dress33 kinds kept with calm34 on (Calm34.Keep; every other dress33 row is cut). research/arenas.md rule 1 (ULTRAKILL devs, 80.lv: "the geometry of a level is simple and clean"; Neon White: "a clean, low detail look with lots of negative space"): cut every prop that is not a surface you use. Kept, each for a purpose: wash (the wall surface itself, K1 5.2: no wall reads as one flat colour), doorFrame + lintelLight (a door reads at a glance), hero (the room's one landmark: where am I), lamp / lampPost / chain / truss (the fixtures that light a room; a lamp keeps its chain and truss, never floating), kilnArch (the kiln mouths' glow), lavaChannel / hazardStripe (danger, red-orange). Cut: skirt, cornice, rib, pilaster, fin, recess, banner, pipes, wallPipe, edgeLight, inlay, debris, scorch, drift, crystal, ingots, stalactite, halo. Never touched: every row with a collider (cover, crates, pillars, consoles), devices, pickups (not dress33 rows). A view list (no sim effect): the web has no dressing at all.

flow34._why: Builder M (NIGHT34.md M1): movement patterns from RESEARCH.md table M that SKYGRIND lacks, each its own sub-switch, in Mover.cs branches only (with the row off every golden vector and trajectory is bit-exact). Builder M adds its numbers with their _why.
flow34.found_why: Grepped first (the mechanism, not the name; Core/Flow34.cs's header): table M 2, no ground friction on a buffered landing jump, ALREADY EXISTS in the web's mover (the buffered jump fires in TryJump before StepGround on the first grounded step, and StepGround skips friction while groundedSteps == 0, SPEC 3.2): not rebuilt, measured by the harness `flow34 bhop`. Coyote and buffer on slides, the buffer onto a wall ride, apex hang (jump.apexHangMult) and corner correction (collision.cornerCorrect) exist too. Each sub-switch below counts only while this row is enabled.

wallCoyote._why: RESEARCH.md table M 1 (research/movement-oss.md pattern 1: 'apply coyote after leaving a wall too'; Celeste JumpGraceTime 0.1 s, dot-player-controller coyote_time 0.1 s, the TF recreation's k_coyoteTime 0.15 s 'ground or wall'): a wall ride that ends on its own (away, timeout, corner, lost, blocked) keeps the wall jump off that wall for `time` s, even past the 0.12 m probe. The web has no wall coyote: its coyote (jump.coyoteTime) starts only when walking or sliding off a floor edge.
wallCoyote.time_why: 0.1 s (12 steps at 120 Hz), the same as the web's floor coyote (jump.coyoteTime 0.1) and Celeste's / dot's 0.1 s.

wallBuffer._why: RESEARCH.md table M 1 (research/movement-oss.md pattern 1: 'let a buffered jump fire on wall contact as a wall jump'): in the air with a double jump left, a press while a valid wall is predicted within the jump buffer (jump.bufferTime, along the horizontal velocity) waits for the wall instead of spending the double jump; on the buffer's last step it is the double jump after all. The web holds a press only for a predicted FLOOR landing (landingSoon); it has no wall prediction. No new number: the window is the web's jump.bufferTime, the facing test the web's wallRide.awayDot.

zipCarry._why: RESEARCH.md table M 7 (research/movement-oss.md pattern 7: 'add, never replace, velocity on release so grapple chains into slide and bhop'; ULTRAKILL / Titanfall 2 keep momentum, DESIGN31 R2): the ZIP pull (the NIGHT31 tap grapple) replaces the velocity with the pull every substep; its release adds back the pre-pull horizontal velocity's part across the release direction, x carryMult. The web's zip (an enemy hook only) has no carry: the release keeps the pull's velocity alone.
zipCarry.carryMult_why: 1 = all of the erased sideways momentum comes back (the research's 'add, never replace'); the pull's own speed along its line is unchanged. NIGHT31's arriveKeepMax (design.n31.grapplePull) still clamps the horizontal speed after an ARRIVAL; a cancel (jump, dash) keeps it all.

ridePhase._why: RESEARCH.md table M 4 (research/movement-oss.md pattern 4: wallrun gravity 'starts at zero and ramps back'; the UCSD CSE125 Titanfall-style student recreation's grip 0 g for 0.5 s then a ramp to full over 1.0 s, no licence: its numbers are tuning hints only, no code): the wall ride's gravity is 0 for gripTime s (only while not rising, so the grip never climbs a wall), then ramps linearly back to the web's wallRide.gravityMult (0.15) over rampTime s. The web's ride has one constant multiplier from its first step.
ridePhase.gripTime_why: The recreation's 0.5 s grip scaled by SKYGRIND's ride length against its ride (wallRide.maxTime 1.2 s vs its 1.75 s: x 0.686 = 0.34 s), rounded to 0.35 s (42 steps).
ridePhase.rampTime_why: The recreation's 1.0 s ramp scaled the same way (0.69 s), 0.7 s (84 steps): grip + ramp = 1.05 s, inside the 1.2 s ride.

lurch._why: RESEARCH.md table M 6 (research/movement-oss.md pattern 6, Titanfall 2's lurch as an idea; the TF recreation: max at 0.2 s, off at 0.5 s, capped, no licence: tuning hints only): ONE steering correction per takeoff (a ground or slide jump): within `window` s of the jump, the first air step whose wish is at least minAngleDeg off the motion turns the horizontal velocity toward it by at most maxTurnDeg, its speed x speedKeep (a lurch costs speed, so it is not free air control). A landing ends it. The web has only its constant air acceleration.
lurch.window_why: Between the recreation's full-strength 0.2 s and its 0.5 s cut-off: 0.3 s (36 steps) after the jump.
lurch.minAngleDeg_why: A change of mind, not a strafe: 45 degrees off the motion before the lurch spends itself (tuning; no source number).
lurch.maxTurnDeg_why: At most 60 degrees of turn in the one step (a full reversal stays impossible; tuning, no source number: the recreation caps speed at 400 u/s instead).
lurch.speedKeep_why: 85 % of the horizontal speed kept through the turn (tuning; the cost keeps bhop speed from being steered for free).

flow34.wallJumps34_why: NOT a sub-switch: ULTRAKILL's 3 wall jumps per airtime reset on landing (currentWallJumps < 3, NewMovement.cs :1038 / :1287) ALREADY is the web's rule: PortExport/config.json wallJump.maxPerAirtime is 3 (Mover.MaxWallJumps = maxPerAirtime + the GRIP perk's bonus; Land() refills it). The addendum's 'movement.wallJumps 1' does not exist in the config. Measured by the harness `flow34 wallJumps`: 3 wall jumps chained between two parallel walls, the row off and on.

slideBounce34._why: rea-ultrakill.md, Movement (ULTRAKILL NewMovement.cs WallJump :1754-1763, read from GG's installed copy with ILSpy; the rule's shape and its numbers only): while sliding, or within startSteps of a slide start, a jump at a wall the slide heads into is a WALL jump that REFLECTS the slide direction off the wall normal, adds push x the normal before renormalising, keeps the full horizontal speed and at least the wall jump's up speed (jump v0 x wallJump.v0Mult; ULTRAKILL keeps at least 15 up in its own units). A normal wall jump keeps the web's rule. The web has no slide-into-wall rule: on the ground a slide's jump is the slide jump.
slideBounce34.push_why: ULTRAKILL's 0.35 of the unit wall normal added to the reflected direction before renormalising (NewMovement.cs :1754-1763).
slideBounce34.startSteps_why: ULTRAKILL's 'within 4 frames of a slide start' (its physics frames), read as 4 sim steps at 120 Hz (33 ms).

reach34._why: Builder M (NIGHT34.md M1): the Pulse Gauntlet's punch and blast reach a boss with bossMargin m added to the boss body's radius (inflate the enemy's hurtbox, keep the player's: RESEARCH.md finding 7). The web has no boss margin. Builder M adds its numbers with their _why.
reach34.bossMargin_why: Metres added to a BOSS body's radius (its capsule's axis kept) for the Pulse Gauntlet only: the click swing's sweep, its parry peek, the F punch, the LT blast (NIGHT27 pulse27) and the NIGHT25 release launch, and the KILN WYRM head-punch stagger's reach (design.n30.wyrm30.headReachMargin's test). Start 0.6 m from NIGHT34.md M1 (GG 2026-10-11: 'a slightly larger active hitbox when striking bosses like the worm'); method: inflate the enemy's hurtbox, keep the player's small, sphere / capsule test (RESEARCH.md finding 7, research/swap-hud.md section 6; no ULTRAKILL melee numbers were found). The web has no boss margin: its gauntlet hit a boss on the body's own radius. Bosses: every IBossBody27 (Lantern, Stag, Loom, Crown, Glacier 27 / 28), the Wyrm, the Glacier 26, the Hulk, the Monolith, Rival Prime and the Bulwark (the blast only: the Bulwark has no punch targets).

air34._why: Builder B (NIGHT34.md leftover 1, C-13): an air / slide multiplier on POINTS and STYLE only, never damage (Core/Air34.cs, Game/SurvivalSim.Air34.cs). It climbs while airborne or sliding and falls back fast on landing; every style award and every combat points payout (hits, kills, parries) is multiplied by it. While on it replaces the web's flat style.stateMult. Off (--off34): NIGHT33's points and style. Source: Research/2026-10-11-wave34/research/arenas.md section 6 (ULTRAKILL's movement multiplier, wiki.gg Style: 'rises 2.0x per second up to 3x while sliding or airborne, falls back to 1x in about 0.2 s on landing'). The web has no such number: its style meter's state multiplier is a flat style.stateMult (1.2) in the air states, and its points have no movement multiplier.
air34.max_why: The multiplier's cap. Research/2026-10-11-wave34/research/arenas.md section 6 (ULTRAKILL's movement multiplier, wiki.gg Style: 'rises 2.0x per second up to 3x while sliding or airborne, falls back to 1x in about 0.2 s on landing'): up to 3x. The web has no such number: its style meter's state multiplier is a flat style.stateMult (1.2) in the air states, and its points have no movement multiplier.
air34.risePerSecond_why: Per second of air or slide, added to the multiplier (1x to 3x in 1 s). Research/2026-10-11-wave34/research/arenas.md section 6 (ULTRAKILL's movement multiplier, wiki.gg Style: 'rises 2.0x per second up to 3x while sliding or airborne, falls back to 1x in about 0.2 s on landing'): 2.0x per second. The web has no such number: its style meter's state multiplier is a flat style.stateMult (1.2) in the air states, and its points have no movement multiplier.
air34.fallSeconds_why: Seconds for a full max multiplier to fall back to 1x once grounded and not sliding (linear, per fixed step). Research/2026-10-11-wave34/research/arenas.md section 6 (ULTRAKILL's movement multiplier, wiki.gg Style: 'rises 2.0x per second up to 3x while sliding or airborne, falls back to 1x in about 0.2 s on landing'): about 0.2 s on landing. The web has no such number: its style meter's state multiplier is a flat style.stateMult (1.2) in the air states, and its points have no movement multiplier.

combo34._why: Builder B (NIGHT34.md leftover 3, C-17): a NAMED COMBO: a grapple latch starts a bend, and kills inside that one bend with two or more different guns (the loadout's guns: ArsenalMath.WeaponOf of the kill's weapon, owned; the whip's hit does not count) stamp a name. The sim emits bend34Combo {name, guns, kills, points} each time the bend's count of different killing guns reaches a new step (2, 3, 4+); the style meter pays the step's bonus (StyleCore.Bonus, the name as its source). Builder H shows the name in hud33's one message slot. Needs bend34 (N34Blocks.combo34 counts only with it). The web has no such number: it has no bend and no named combos across guns (its style meter's cross combos are pairs of verbs, not a bend).
combo34.names_why: The combo's name by the number of different killing guns inside one bend: 2, 3, 4 or more (the last one repeats). Short and loud for hud33's one message slot (text >= 16 px). Unity-only names, the forge's choice (NIGHT34.md C-17: 'grapple -> bend -> two different guns -> kill stamps a combo name'). The web has no such number: it has no bend and no named combos across guns (its style meter's cross combos are pairs of verbs, not a bend).
combo34.stylePoints_why: The style bonus per step (2, 3, 4+ guns), before the meter's multipliers. Read against PortExport/config.json: style.base.huskKill 30, style.bonus.multikill 25, airshot 12; so a 2-gun bend combo pays five husk kills' style, a 4-gun one about thirteen. The forge's choice, logged as such. The web has no such number: it has no bend and no named combos across guns (its style meter's cross combos are pairs of verbs, not a bend).
combo34.arsenal_why: Sub-switch (under the combo34 bit): ARSENAL. A kill on an enemy that was hit by two or more different owned guns (any time, not only inside a bend; the whip's hit not counted) pays arsenalStyle and emits arsenal34 (GG's sound hook). Rule shape from Research/2026-10-11-wave34/research/rea-ultrakill.md 'Weapon switching' (EnemyIdentifier.cs: +50 style when an enemy dies having been hit by more than one weapon, per enemy, no time window). The web has no such number: it has no weapon-switch rewards in its style meter (no ARSENAL, no QUICKDRAW) and no whip.
combo34.arsenalStyle_why: Style points for ARSENAL, before the meter's multipliers. ULTRAKILL pays 50 where a kill is about 50-100 (Research/2026-10-11-wave34/research/rea-ultrakill.md); scaled to SKYGRIND's units by our kill award, style.base.huskKill 30 (PortExport/config.json): 50 / 75 (the middle of 50-100) x 30 = 20. The web has no such number: it has no weapon-switch rewards in its style meter (no ARSENAL, no QUICKDRAW) and no whip.
combo34.quickdraw_why: Sub-switch (under the combo34 bit): QUICKDRAW. A hit with the gun in hand within quickdrawS after it came into hand (the loadout's weaponRaise) pays quickdrawStyle, once per swap, and emits quickdraw34 (GG's sound hook). Rule shape from Research/2026-10-11-wave34/research/rea-ultrakill.md 'Weapon switching' (Shotgun.cs, RevolverBeam.cs, Coin.cs: +50 style for a hit while the weapon's equip animation still plays). The web has no such number: it has no weapon-switch rewards in its style meter (no ARSENAL, no QUICKDRAW) and no whip.
combo34.quickdrawS_why: Seconds after the raise (whole 120 Hz steps) a hit still counts as QUICKDRAW. ULTRAKILL's window is its equip animation; Research/2026-10-11-wave34/research/rea-ultrakill.md gives no seconds for it, so 0.25 s is the lead's start (about ULTRAKILL's 0.25 s tap / wheel threshold, WeaponWheelTime), to be judged in the Player. The web has no such number: it has no weapon-switch rewards in its style meter (no ARSENAL, no QUICKDRAW) and no whip.
combo34.quickdrawStyle_why: Style points for QUICKDRAW, before the meter's multipliers: ULTRAKILL's 50 scaled as arsenalStyle (50 / 75 x style.base.huskKill 30 = 20). The web has no such number: it has no weapon-switch rewards in its style meter (no ARSENAL, no QUICKDRAW) and no whip.
combo34.whipReady_why: Sub-switch (under the combo34 bit): a whip latch (whip33Latch) sets the Pulse Gauntlet's punch cooldown (and its swing's cycle in hand) to at most whipReadyS, so grapple -> punch always links (Loadout.ReadyPunch34). Rule shape from Research/2026-10-11-wave34/research/rea-ultrakill.md 'The Whiplash' (HookArm.cs: throwing the hook sets fistCooldown to at most 0.1). The web has no such number: it has no weapon-switch rewards in its style meter (no ARSENAL, no QUICKDRAW) and no whip.
combo34.whipReadyS_why: Seconds (whole 120 Hz steps: 12) the punch waits at most after a whip latch. Research/2026-10-11-wave34/research/rea-ultrakill.md 'The Whiplash': 0.1 (HookArm.cs, fistCooldown capped at 0.1f). The web has no such number: it has no weapon-switch rewards in its style meter (no ARSENAL, no QUICKDRAW) and no whip.

n35._why: NIGHT35, the fundamentals night (GG 2026-10-11 ~19:28 after playing n34, verbatim in Research/2026-10-11-wave35/GG-REQUEST.md: 'the pistol lost the ability to charge and fire same with the shotgun'; a picked-up weapon shows no model; ULTRAKILL-style text that teaches each mechanic; the grapple 'shouldn't go limp ... it needs to take you to wherever you fire' and unlocks 'like the 4th or 5th level'; a 'bluer overlay' when wall riding + zooming; the healing item doesn't read; 'six levels total'; the lights 'crappy ... cheesy'; the PS2 look 'and it really shows'; the UI 'glitching out like a TV'; wall riding 'a lot more like Lucio'). Every row is off in the shared commit and turned on only when its check passes. Off (--off35 / -skygrindOff35, and every older off switch): NIGHT34's game bit for bit. Plan: NIGHT35.md; defaults: DECIDE35.md; principles: docs/PRINCIPLES.md; verbs: docs/VERBS.md; research: Research/2026-10-11-wave35/.

charge35._why: NIGHT35 W1 P0 (DECIDE35 D-8; audit.md item 1): the KESTREL's and THE THUNDERCLAP's charge as its own trigger: a press-and-hold charges at once with NO normal shots first, a tap fires a normal shot at the release, the release of a FULL charge fires the charged shot (pierce33's beam / the slug, as NIGHT33 left them), a full charge held holdMaxS more fires itself, then a short fixed cooldown gates the next charge (a press or hold while it runs is today's normal fire). ULTRAKILL's revolver charges on its own input with no shots first (Research/2026-10-11-wave34/research/rea-ultrakill.md). Needs design.n31.charge on (its object and its fullSeconds: KESTREL 0.5 s, THUNDERCLAP 0.7 s, counted from the press). Code: Core/Guns/Charge35.cs. Off: NIGHT31's rule (0.4 s of auto-fire, then the charge), bit-exact.
charge35.tapS_why: A hold shorter than this (whole steps: 12 at 120 Hz) is a TAP: no charge cue starts (charge35Start fires only past it). A press released before FULL always fires one normal shot, so this only decides when the charge reads as begun. 0.1 s: a deliberate tap on a pad trigger or a mouse button is 50-100 ms (guess, logged).
charge35.holdMaxS_why: A FULL charge still held this long fires itself (n31's autoReleaseSeconds was 0.5 s): long enough to line up a pierce through a crowd, short enough that a held trigger (the smoke's virtual pad, the walk / attract bots) never stalls the gun more than full + 1 s. ULTRAKILL holds a full charge until release; the bots need it to end (guess, logged).

revolver.cooldownS_why: After a charged KESTREL shot, no new charge for this long (a press or hold in it is the normal fire). design.n31.charge's _why R3: ULTRAKILL's piercer about 0.5 s charge, 2.5 s cooldown (n31 used 4 s and read as 'lost'). With pierce33's x9 (225 per body) the KESTREL's sustained output rises about a quarter over n34's hold pattern; the boss band is re-measured by the lead (N-11).

shotgun.cooldownS_why: After a charged THUNDERCLAP slug, no new charge for this long. The slug is a whole volley's damage x damageMult on one line, so it keeps a longer gap than the KESTREL (n31: 6 s vs 4 s, the same 1.5 ratio kept loosely): 3 s (guess, logged).

pickup35._why: NIGHT35 W1 pickups (PRINCIPLES 3; audit.md items 2 and 4; DECIDE35 D-5): a VIEW row (no sim bit). A weapon pickup shows that weapon's own kit model (BlockyKit.ForWeapon, as SURVIVAL's wall buys), turning and bobbing, with a cyan rim and its name on approach; a pickup in a room the player has not reached yet shows the gun's dark silhouette (CoD's chalk outline); a wall buy the player cannot afford shows the same silhouette. The health pickup is a cyan vial (never a red cross: a protected emblem, research/teach.md section 2) with a pulse and 'MEND +N' on approach. Code: Game/PropsView29.cs, Game/Pickup35View.cs, Game/WallBuys.cs; numbers in UnityTuning.Weapons35.cs. Off (or -skygrindOff35): NIGHT34's cubes.

wallride35._why: Builder M (NIGHT35.md M1, DECIDE35 D-6: the new ride on, the old ride is this row off): the Lucio wall ride (Research/2026-10-11-wave35/research/lucio.md, its spec 1-10; Core/Ride35.cs, Mover.cs branches marked NIGHT35 wallride35; with the row off every golden vector and trajectory is bit-exact). A ride entered with jump HELD rides while it stays held (no 1.2 s timer), the release is the jump-off (up speed from the look pitch, an exit boost), crouch drops off; corners and pillars are followed; a re-ride rule; a late jump. A ride entered without jump held is the web's timed ride. The web's ride: wallRide.maxTime 1.2 s, entrySpeed 4 m/s along the wall, press = wall jump, crouch = slam.
wallride35.enabled_why: Kept as the file has it (the lead turns rows on; D-6's default is on).
wallride35.entrySpeed_why: LOGGED (the entry gate lowered, NIGHT35.md M1): a HOLD ride starts at 1 m/s along the wall (the web's wallRide.entrySpeed 4), and a head-on hold entry rides the way the camera faces at the approach speed. Lucio has no documented minimum speed (lucio.md spec 9: 'not found'; 'jump at a nearby wall and hold the Jump key', overwatch.fandom.com/wiki/Wall_Ride). A ride without jump held keeps the web's 4.
wallride35.speedBuff_why: The ride's speed floor is wallRide.minSpeed (8) x (1 + 0.3) = 10.4 m/s on any ride: Lucio's 'speed buff reduced from 40% to 30%' (late 2019, west-games.com/overwatch-lucio-changes) and the wiki's '+30% movement speed buff' (lucio.md section 1). The web's floor is 8 m/s.
wallride35.exitBoost_why: Metres per second added to the horizontal speed at a jump-off (never past chainCap), so a chain of rides builds speed: Lucio's 'burst of speed when leaping off a wall' (April 2017) raised 65 % in Oct 2017 (overwatch.blizzard.com patch notes 2017/10; lucio.md section 1, spec 3). Blizzard published no magnitude: 2 m/s is ours (about a fifth of the ride's 10.4 m/s floor), to be tuned on Player frames.
wallride35.chainCap_why: The exit boost never lifts the horizontal speed past 20 m/s (a faster entry keeps its own speed): ours, under the slide jump's cap (slide.jumpBoostMaxSpeed 24) so a slide-hop stays the fastest takeoff; Lucio's air speed thresholds (11 / 13.76 / 17.6 m/s, the wiki, lucio.md section 1) are of the same order.
wallride35.outSpeed_why: The jump-off's speed straight out from the wall: the web's wallJump.outSpeed (8), unchanged.
wallride35.upLow_why: The jump-off's up speed looking down (at pitchLowDeg): the wiki's 4.12 m/s (overwatch.fandom.com/wiki/Lucio, lucio.md section 1, spec 4; not verified against a datamine).
wallride35.upHigh_why: The jump-off's up speed looking up (at pitchHighDeg): the wiki's 9.12 m/s (same source). The web's wall jump: jump v0 8.33 x wallJump.v0Mult 0.9 = 7.5 m/s whatever the pitch.
wallride35.pitchLowDeg_why: The look pitch (degrees, + is up) that gives upLow; between the two the up speed is linear, clamped outside. Ours: the wiki says only 'looking down' / 'looking up'.
wallride35.pitchHighDeg_why: The look pitch that gives upHigh (ours, as pitchLowDeg). Level look (0): 6.62 m/s up.
wallride35.riseGravityMult_why: A HOLD ride entered rising brakes at full gravity until it stops rising (a 7 m/s rising entry lifts about 1 m more), so a hold ride is a level line at about the height it met the wall. The web's ride climbs at wallRide.gravityMult 0.15 (7 m from a 7 m/s entry): round 2, a hold ride met a 4 m wall rising and rode off its top in 0.7-1.2 s (verbs35 row 9 on n35-kiln). A ride WITHOUT jump held keeps the web's 0.15 climb, and a flue is climbed by the release's jump-off looking up (up to upHigh 9.12 m/s; Walk29Pilot's flue script does). Lucio's on-wall gravity was not found (lucio.md spec 8).
wallride35.sinkSpeed_why: Once not rising, a HOLD ride sinks at a constant 0.1 m/s (0.3 m over a 30 m wall at 10.4 m/s): Lucio rides level for as long as jump is held ('as long as it is held', lucio.md section 1; on-wall gravity not found). Round 2: 0.3 m/s landed a ride begun 0.6 m up in 2 s (verbs35 row 9's low entry); 0.1 still reads as a ride, not a hover.
wallride35.attachReach_why: In the air with jump held, a valid wall within 0.5 m beside the motion (a ray left and right of the horizontal velocity) draws the player onto it, so a near miss rides ('jump at a nearby wall and hold the Jump key', overwatch.fandom.com/wiki/Wall_Ride; lucio.md spec 1, 9). Ours (round 2: verbs35 row 9 ran along a wall 0.35 m off it and landed before touching). The web needs a contact.
wallride35.attachPull_why: The speed into that wall while it draws (m/s): 0.5 m closes in about 0.13 s. Ours.
wallride35.safetyCap_why: LOGGED (the 1.2 s cap removed, NIGHT35.md M1): a HOLD ride ends by itself only after 8 s (83 m at 10.4 m/s; the event's reason 'safety', counted), a guard against a stuck ride, never a meter. Lucio: no time limit ('as long as it is held'; an official numeric limit not found, lucio.md section 1).
wallride35.cornerMinHold_why: A HOLD ride (jump held) follows corners, only after 0.35 s on the wall (a ride without jump held keeps the web's corner end; round 2: following corners on every ride stalled the walk bot 0 / 4 in n33-spire v6): OW May 3 2018, 'Added a minimum time that the jump key must be held before Lucio can ride around corners' (over.gg/8166; lucio.md spec 5). Blizzard's value is not published: 0.35 s (42 steps) is ours, round 2: at 0.1 s a ride into a wall-jump flue's back wall turned out of the flue at its corner before the climb's wall jump (n35-foundry f4, the walk bot 0 / 10); a flue's corner comes inside 0.35 s, a lane's corner after it.
wallride35.followMaxDeg_why: Inside corners (a wall ahead) and outside corners (the wall ends, the next face behind the ride's direction) up to 100 degrees off the ridden wall turn the ride onto the new face at the same speed (OW May 3 2018: 'Can now go around corners (both outside corners, and inside corners) without having to leave the wall', lucio.md spec 5). 100 covers a box's 90 degree corners and any pillar's facets; a sharper V ends the ride ('corner'). The web ends a ride at any contact more than wallRide.cornerAngleDeg (30) off.
wallride35.reRideDeg_why: The re-ride rule: a wall facing within 30 degrees of the last ridden one counts as the same wall (the community's 'same-facing wall', mobalytics.gg lucio-guide, lucio.md section 1; 30 = the web's wallRide.cornerAngleDeg).
wallride35.reRideDistance_why: The same (or same-facing) wall starts no new ride until a landing or until the player is 3 m (horizontal) from where the last ride ended: OW May 3 2018, 'Can now land back on the same wall after leaping away, provided his leap takes him far enough away' (lucio.md spec 6). Blizzard's distance is not published: 3 m is ours (a jump-off carries about 4.9 m out before it falls to its takeoff height: the harness `n35move ride`).
wallride35.lateJump_why: 0.2 s (24 steps) after a ride ends on its own (away, lost, corner, blocked, timeout, safety, a crouch drop), a jump press or the release of a hold ride's jump is still the jump-off: OW Oct 23 2020, 'within 0.2 seconds will provide a jump boost' (crouch then release; overwatch.blizzard.com patch notes ptr 2020/10) and the community's late jump (lucio.md spec 7).
wallride35.lostGrace_why: A ride whose wall probe finds nothing for up to 0.05 s (6 steps) keeps riding: the web's collider reports a capsule touching a vertical box or pillar edge as an edge contact, never a wall (its point is at the edge's end), so a ride sliding over a pillar's facet edge or clearing an outside corner would otherwise end 'lost' for one step. Ours (an engine fact, not a Lucio number).
wallride35.stick_why: A speed of 1 m/s into the wall on every ride step (the contact clips it: no speed is lost on a flat wall) keeps the capsule on a curved wall's face (a pillar) while the ride's normal is re-sampled every step (lucio.md spec 5: 're-sample the wall normal each step'). Ours: no source documents a stick force (lucio.md section 3: 'not found').

grapple35._why: Builder M (NIGHT35.md M1, D-2, D-9; audit.md item 3; GG 2026-10-11: the grapple 'shouldn't go limp ... it needs to take you to wherever you fire' and unlock 'like the 4th or 5th level'): every hook that goes out (a node, a bare wall, a big enemy's zip; a small enemy is the whip's) is a straight pull at once, held or not, at the NIGHT31 pull's constant speed (design.n31.grapplePull.speed), and stops at the hit point (ULTRAKILL's HookArm: a constant pull, no swing, rea-ultrakill.md :1545). A bare wall is never refused (design.n32.grapple32.tapNodesOnly is cleared). A second press, a jump in the air or a dash still let go. Outside the Mover (GrappleTap31.pullOnFire, SurvivalSim.Move35.cs; the Mover's own zip is the pull). The web has no grapple pull.
grapple35.fromLevel_why: D-2: the grapple is owned in the campaign from the level at this place in the campaign order (1-based) on; before it (levels 1-3) the auto-own leaves it unowned (grapple35Here false), and with it the bend (bend34 fires on a rope latch). Off: NIGHT34's rule (owned on any level with nodes).
grapple35.swing_why: D-9: the hold-to-swing (NIGHT30's pendulum, NIGHT31's hold past the 0.2 s tap window) is gone under grapple35; true keeps NIGHT31 / 32's tap-pull / hold-swing split (a bare wall still not refused).
grapple35.arriveKeepMax_why: 'Stops there': the horizontal speed kept when the pull lets go at the anchor (the Mover's zip release, arcline.zip.arrive 2.6 m short) is clamped to 4 m/s (NIGHT31's design.n31.grapplePull.arriveKeepMax 12 slid on past the point: audit.md item 3, 'arriveKeepMax decides how dead the arrival feels'). 4 m/s: half the walk speed, enough to touch a wall the pull hit (a wall ride can start from it). A cancel before the arrival keeps its speed (NIGHT32's cancelKeepMax 20).
grapple35.arrivePop_why: Metres per second added upward at the arrival (NIGHT31's arrivePop 5 cleared a ledge after a long carry): 3 m/s (about 0.2 m up) so the arrival is a stop with a small lift, not a hop over the point.

teach35._why: Builder T (NIGHT35.md T1, D-7, PRINCIPLES 2): ULTRAKILL-style teaching text (Core/Lesson25.cs Teach35, Game/SurvivalSim.Teach35.cs, Ui teach35 in the hud33 message slot). A line fires once per PROFILE (Profile.teach35; a fresh profile sees every line, D-7) when the feet enter its rect (the level file's campaign.teach35, builder A) or, with no rect, on the first entry into its fallback `room`; a `weapon` line on that weapon's first weaponEarned. {action} tokens are the player's live button (pad glyph words or the bound key). Format (teach.md section 1, ULTRAKILL 0-1): the verb in capitals, the button, at most one rule. `needs`: the NIGHT35 block the words describe (off: textOff, or no line). The web has no tutorial (Unity-only words). Off (row off, --off35 / -skygrindOff35): nothing fires, NIGHT34's lessons only.
teach35.showS_why: ULTRAKILL HudMessage timerTime 5 s (Research/2026-10-11-wave35/RESEARCH.md table: teaching text time 5 s, once).
teach35.maxChars_why: The message slot is one 640 px line at 24 px (UnityTuning.Hud33SlotW, the slot's px): about 52 characters of the label face fit; the harness check teach35 resolves every line with the keyboard words (LEFT CLICK, L-SHIFT) and refuses a longer one.

lines.text: PRESS {dash} to DASH. Works in the air.
HOLD {slide} to SLIDE. You keep your speed.
HOLD {fire} to CHARGE. Release to fire.
lines.textOff: HOLD {fire} to CHARGE. The shot pierces.

lines.text: WALL RUN: JUMP AT THE WALL, HOLD {forward}, THEN JUMP OFF THE TOP TO GO UP
lines.textPad: WALL RUN: JUMP AT THE WALL, HOLD {forward}, THEN JUMP OFF THE TOP TO GO UP

lines.text: HOLD {altFire} to ZOOM. Aim on a wall slows time.
HOLD {jump} on a WALL to WALL RIDE. Let go to leap.
lines.textOff: PRESS {jump} at a WALL to WALL RIDE.

lines.text: PRESS {jump} on a WALL to WALL JUMP. Chain them.
HOLD {fire} to CHARGE a SLUG. Release to fire.
lines.textOff: HOLD {fire} to CHARGE a SLUG. It cracks armour.

lines.text: PRESS {grapple} to GRAPPLE. It pulls you to the hit.
lines.textOff: TAP {grapple} to PULL. HOLD to SWING.

lines.text: LATCH with {grapple} to BEND time. SWAP guns in it.
AIM {grapple} at an enemy to WHIP. Then PUNCH.
THE STITCHER. HOLD {fire} to STREAM nails.
