tap36._why: Builder F (NIGHT36.md F1; REVIEW.md root cause 1: charge35 fires a tap on RELEASE, Charge35.cs:114-142): a tap fires on the press, always; a hold past holdStartS charges a second shot fired on release (ULTRAKILL: the revolver's tap is always instant, its charge never delays it: rea-ultrakill-combat.md section 1). Builder F adds its numbers with their _why.
tap36.holdStartS_why: NIGHT36.md F1 (start 0.18 s): a press held longer than this (whole steps: 22 at 120 Hz) is a real hold and starts the charge (charge35Start, the HUD's CHARGING); shorter is a tap, which already fired ON its press. Above a deliberate click (50-100 ms, design.n35.charge35.tapS_why) with room for a slow pad trigger; under the KESTREL's 0.5 s full charge (design.n31.charge.revolver.fullSeconds, counted from the press as before), so the charge reads 0.32 s of filling. ULTRAKILL keeps the tap instant and the charge on its own input (rea-ultrakill-combat.md section 1, Revolver.cs:351-392): here one button, split by this time.

crunch36._why: Builder F (NIGHT36.md F1; REVIEW.md root cause 3: a KESTREL body hit gets no freeze, ImpactRules.cs:19-30): a short freeze on every body hit inside the freeze budget, 0.1 s per punch hit (ULTRAKILL Punch.cs: HitStop 0.1), a stagger and visible knockback. Builder F adds its numbers with their _why.
crunch36.bodyHitS_why: NIGHT36.md F1 / REVIEW.md root cause 3 (a KESTREL body hit had no freeze, ImpactRules.cs:19-30): a 15-20 ms freeze on every non-kill gun body hit (18 ms: about one 60 fps frame, so it reads as a catch, not a stall). ULTRAKILL freezes 0.05 s on the revolver beam (REVIEW.md root cause 3); ours is shorter because it fires far more often (every pellet volley, every nail cycle).
crunch36.bodyHitCooldownS_why: The shortest real time between two body-hit freezes, so the STITCHER's stream (about 10 nails a second) freezes at most ~6.7 times a second: 6.7 x 0.018 = 0.12 s/s, inside design.impact.budget.perSecond 0.2 with room for a kill. The KESTREL (0.4 s interval) never meets it.
crunch36.bodyBudgetPerSecond_why: Body-hit freezes take at most this many real seconds in any rolling second (their own cap, half of design.impact.budget.perSecond 0.2, which still caps every freeze together); they never count toward the rolling minute's perMinute, so a long fight's body hits never starve the kill / headshot / punch freezes. Guess, logged.
crunch36.punchHitS_why: ULTRAKILL: every punch hit freezes 0.1 s (REVIEW.md root cause 3; design.n36.crunch36._why: Punch.cs HitStop 0.1). Replaces design.impact.freeze.punchHit (0.06) while the row is on; the punch kill (punchKill 0.108) stays longer.

tells36._why: Builder P (NIGHT36.md P1; PLAN.md section 1): every enemy attack that can hit the player gets a pose + colour tell: YELLOW parryable, RED dodge only; 1-1.5 s wind-ups for melee and big shots (design-web.md rule 5; ULTRAKILL's Filth tracks during the wind-up then locks). Builder P adds its numbers with their _why.
tells36._whyNumbers: P (NIGHT36 tells36): huskWindupS 1.0 (the web 0.5) and spitterTellS 1.0 (the web 0.6): Birkhead "beyond 2 seconds I start counting", design-web.md rule 5, 1-1.5 s for melee and big shots (the low end: these are the commonest attacks); a husk melee and a spitter volley are YELLOW (parryable: the punch in the wind-up, the glob punched back). swarmerTellS 0.6 (the web 0.3): a 10 HP flanker whose pounce is RED (dodge); doubled so the red tell is seen, kept under 1 s because a slow swarmer stops being a threat at all. droneChargeS 1.0 (the web 0.4; its fireInterval 2 s is kept, so one orb every 2 s): a big shot, YELLOW (the orb is parried back at the drone). chargerTellS 1.2 (the web 0.8): the middle of the 1-1.5 s band for the biggest body (150 hp at 22 m/s), RED (dodge). The LANCER keeps the web aimTime 1.2 s (already in the band) and is RED: a hitscan beam from a far perch no punch reaches. The web numbers come back with the row off.

parry36._why: Builder P (NIGHT36.md P1): a punch meeting a yellow attack or projectile (with an early buffer) is a parry: a freeze, projectiles return and explode, melee attackers stagger, it heals and refills one dash (ULTRAKILL: parry TrueStop 0.25, ~0.12 s early buffer: rea-ultrakill.md, rea-ultrakill-combat.md section 3). Builder P adds its numbers with their _why.
parry36._whyNumbers: P (NIGHT36 parry36): bufferS 0.12 = ULTRAKILL parryFramesLeft 6 x 0.02 s (Enemy.cs:2698-2842, Punch.cs:524; rea-ultrakill-combat.md section 3). freezeS 0.25 = ULTRAKILL parry TrueStop 0.25 (PLAN.md table; design.ultra.parryHitstop is the same 0.25). returnBurstDamage 40 = one husk (husk.hp 40) or two thirds of a spitter (spitter.hp 60): the returned glob (orb.reflectDamageMult x globDamage = 24 on the shooter) plus the burst kills the spitter that threw it; returnBurstRadius 3 = the spitter puddleRadius (3 m), the size the player already reads as the acid splash.

launch36._why: Builder P (NIGHT36.md P1; GG: 'explosions'): a punch thrown while dashing, sliding, wall riding or grapple-pulled launches the enemy; a launched enemy hitting another or a wall bursts (hurts enemies only). Builder P adds its numbers with their _why.
launch36._whyNumbers: P (NIGHT36 launch36): speed 16 m/s x flightS 0.8 s = a ~12 m throw, the length of one n36 room (12-24 m, PLAN.md section 3), so a launch reaches a wall or another body in the same room; lift 5 m/s keeps it off the floor for ~0.5 s at the sim gravity (a visible arc, not a slide). graceS 0.15: a punch just after a dash / slide ends still counts (the dash is short; ULTRAKILL keeps slide momentum). armS 0.05: the flier ignores walls for its first 6 steps (it starts next to the player, maybe on a wall-ride wall). burstDamage 60 = the spitter hp (60) and over the husk hp (40): "a launched husk into a husk = two kills" (NIGHT36.md P1 check); burstRadius 3.5 m = a crowd of 2-3 at husk.separationRadius spacing. hitPad 0.3 m: bodies touching or about to (one step at 16 m/s is 0.13 m). wallProbe 0.35 m ahead and |n.y| < 0.5 = a face steeper than 60 degrees is a wall; wallProbeLift 0.25 m: the probe capsule is raised so a body sliding on the floor reads the wall, not the floor (the floor contact bent the aggregated normal up).

heal36._why: Builder P (NIGHT36.md P1, DECIDE36 D-5): a kill within a short radius spills health; pickups stay (ULTRAKILL: blood heals on touch: rea-ultrakill-combat.md section 6). Builder P adds its numbers with their _why.
heal36._whyNumbers: P (NIGHT36 heal36; DECIDE36 D-5): radius 4 m and amount 10 HP = PLAN.md section 1 / NIGHT36.md P1 starting numbers ("a kill within ~4 m spills health ... start 10 HP, radius 4 m"); ULTRAKILL heals by touching the blood for 0.25 s (Bloodsplatter.cs:92-176) with per-gore amounts not checked; 10 of 100 is a husk hit (husk.meleeDamage) won back by one close kill.

wallgrip36._why: Builder M (NIGHT36.md M1; REVIEW.md root cause 4: a rising entry keeps its rise and climbs ~7 m at 0.15 gravity, Mover.cs StartRide's 'rising entries keep rising', Flow34.cs RideGravity): on attach the upward speed is clamped to a small kick, the arrival speed along the wall is kept, a grip near level then a slow sink (ULTRAKILL: 'There is no upward motion from touching a wall', rea-ultrakill-combat.md section 5, NewMovement.cs Cling :820-858). Core/Grip36.cs; Mover.cs branches marked NIGHT36 wallgrip36, inside the NIGHT35 wallride35 branches only (needs wallride35 on). Off: wallride35's ride bit for bit.
wallgrip36.attachUpMax_why: m/s: the most upward speed a ride keeps at the attach (NIGHT36.md M1 and PLAN.md F5's start value; ULTRAKILL keeps none: its cling applies only while already falling faster than 1 m/s, rea-ultrakill-combat.md section 5). A jump's 8.33 m/s (jump.height 1.5 / apexTime 0.36) at the wall kept its rise before; at 1.5 m/s braked at full gravity (23.1 m/s2) it rises 0.05 m.
wallgrip36.riseGravityMult_why: The gravity multiplier while the kept kick still rises: full gravity, so the ride never climbs (the web's ride climbs at wallRide.gravityMult 0.15: 7 m from a 7 m/s entry; wallride35's hold ride already braked at 1 = its riseGravityMult). Same value as design.n35.wallride35.riseGravityMult, now for every ride.
wallgrip36.gripTime_why: Seconds from the attach that the ride holds its height (no gravity, no sink): design.n34.flow34.ridePhase.gripTime (0.35 s, 42 steps: the Titanfall-style recreation's 0.5 s grip scaled to SKYGRIND's 1.2 s ride), the grip GG's ride already had for a falling entry.
wallgrip36.sinkAccel_why: m/s per s: a timed ride (jump not held: the web's 1.2 s ride) sinks after the grip, its sink speed growing by this much each second (ULTRAKILL's cling slide grows ~8 m/s per s, rea-ultrakill-combat.md section 5: ours is the card's 'slow sink'). 1.5 gives about 0.5 m over the rest of a 1.2 s ride, the drop ridePhase's ramp gave a falling entry before (0 g for 0.35 s, then 0.15 g ramped in over 0.7 s: ~0.5 m). A HOLD ride keeps design.n35.wallride35.sinkSpeed (0.1 m/s) after the grip.
wallgrip36.sinkMax_why: m/s: the timed ride's sink never passes this (reached 1 s after the grip, past the ride's 1.2 s end: a cap for bonusRideTime's longer rides). Ours.

walkin36._why: Builder B (NIGHT36.md B1; REVIEW.md root cause 5: every boss but THE LOOM begins with a Respawn into a far arena, Campaign24.cs:571-575): the boss fights in the level's last room, reached through a door; the reveal happens in view; no cut. Builder B adds its numbers with their _why.
walkin36.lockSeconds_why: The entry slab closes this long after the player enters the hall (ULTRAKILL: the doors lock on entry, Door.cs:705-758; a short slide so the lock is seen, not a cut). Design/levels/n36/lantern-hall.spec.md step 1.
walkin36.cardSeconds_why: The name card (BossKit bossIntro and the bar) shows this long into the reveal, while the lantern rises (hall spec step 4: the boss is seen before it is named).

boss36._why: Builder B (NIGHT36.md B1; PLAN.md section 4): the shared boss shape (three attacks with pose + colour tells, punish windows, a 50 % stun, an anti-camp attack; no added health: band 15-22 s for the bot, GG w31-w32) and THE LANTERN on it. Builder B adds its numbers with their _why.
boss36.restP1_why: Seconds between attacks before the 50 % change (a breath to reposition; the wall ride covers ~17 m in 1.6 s at 10.45 m/s: n35-ride-distances.json rideSpeed).
boss36.restP2_why: After the change the rests shorten (Birkhead beat structure: escalation after the midpoint; design-web.md section 3). Tells stay 1-1.5 s.
boss36.stunAt_why: The stun at half the bar (Gabriel: at 50 % he is launched and stunned, a free damage window, then phase 2; design-web.md section 3 / rule 6).
boss36.stunSeconds_why: The free-hit window: long enough to reach the well from the wall (15 m at ~9 m/s sprint = 1.7 s) and land a combo (Birkhead: a punish window = one full combo plus travel).
boss36.campSeconds_why: V2 enrages after 6 s of distance/hiding (distancePatience +2/s to 12, V2.cs:708-731; rea-ultrakill-combat.md V2): the anti-camp attack comes after 6 s in one spot off the walls.
boss36.campRadius_why: Staying within 4 m of one spot counts as camping (a strafe in place; leaving it, or riding a wall, resets the clock).

lantern._why: THE LANTERN on Boss36 (Core/Enemies/Lantern36.cs): fought in level 1's last room (Lantern36Arena at the room row's lantern36.centre). Every number is Unity-only (the web had no lantern).
lantern.name: THE LANTERN
lantern.pool_why: The bar (no added health, GG w31-w32: band 15-22 s for the bot; harness `boss36 band` measures it). Start value, tuned by the harness.
lantern.coreY_why: The core 4.5 m up: level with a rider (a ride runs at 2-6 m), looked up at from the floor (hall spec).
lantern.bodyR_why: The hit sphere: the drawn cage is 2.3 m wide x UnityTuning.Body36Scale 1.4 = 3.2 m (1.6 m half, the plates ajar a little more), the sphere 1.9 m so the hit volume covers the drawn body (hurt32: at least the drawn model; the lead n36-r3: the body read small, scaled 1.4x).
lantern.stunY_why: In the stun the lantern drops onto the well: the core at chest height from the floor (hall spec).
lantern.punishY_why: In a punish the lantern sags so the floor can reach it too (the open core's floor share applies).
lantern.riseFrom_why: The reveal: it rises out of the well from 4 m below the floor (hall spec step 3).
lantern.riseSeconds_why: The rise inside the reveal (hall spec: 0.5-3.0 s).
lantern.revealSeconds_why: The reveal's length: no damage until the fight starts (hall spec step 5; the name card shows at 1.0 s).
lantern.moveRate_why: m/s the core moves between its heights (sag, stun drop, back up): readable, not a snap.

shield._why: The shield (kept from n31: full damage only from the wall; the charged KESTREL from the wall breaks it) plus the parry (NIGHT36: yellow orbs parried back crack it).
shield.lightRide_why: The share a closed shield lets through to a rider (n29 lightDamage 0.06 made the floor useless; 0.25 keeps any wall shot worth it).
shield.lightFloor_why: The share from the floor with the shield up (n29 R4: 0.06 kept the floor bot from killing it in 145 s): the floor is not the answer.
shield.openFloor_why: With the core open (punish, broken shield) a floor shot lands half (n31 floorScale 0.5).
shield.chargedMin_why: A charged KESTREL shot (n31 chargedMinDamage: the charge is 4 x 25 = 100) from the wall breaks the shield.
shield.coreOpenSeconds_why: The broken shield stays open 3 s (n32 bosses32 lantern: the core open longer than n31's 2 s; one ride's worth of shots).
shield.rideGraceSeconds_why: A shot fired this soon after leaving the wall still counts as from the wall (n27 shield grace 0.35).
shield.parryDamage_why: A parried orb lands this on the core (web orb.reflectDamageMult x2 of a 14-hp orb = 28, raised so the parry is the best answer: two parries ~ one charged shot).
shield.cracksToBreak_why: Two parried orbs break the shield (one fan has three: a clean parry run breaks it every fan).
shield.parryReach_why: A punch parries an orb within 3 m of the eye (punch.range 2 m + the orb's 9 m/s x ULTRAKILL's 0.12 s early buffer ~ 1.1 m).
shield.parryConeDeg_why: Half-angle of the parry cone (punch.coneHalfAngleDeg 35, widened: a parry should not need pixel aim).
shield.parryBufferSeconds_why: ULTRAKILL: a punch up to ~0.12 s early still parries (parryFramesLeft 6 at 0.02 s, Enemy.cs:2698-2842; rea-ultrakill-combat.md section 3).

fan._why: THE ORB FAN (YELLOW, parry): the cage opens, the core flares yellow for the tell, then fanCount slow orbs at the player.
fan.activeSeconds_why: The fan's flight time before the next rest (15 m at 9 m/s ~ 1.7 s: the orbs are still flying at the rest's start).
fan.count_why: Three orbs (n27 fanCount 3): two parried break the shield.
fan.deg_why: Degrees between orbs (n27 fanDeg 16, tighter so a parry meets one).
fan.speed_why: m/s, slow and readable (n27 orb speed 9).
fan.leadSeconds_why: Unused since the lead pass (kept for the record: the first fan aimed velocity x 0.4 s ahead, and a rider at 10 m/s was missed for free: the 18:15 note of the lead).
fan.leadMaxSeconds_why: The fan leads the player along his motion round the hall for the flight time of an orb (15 m / 9 m/s = 1.7 s), capped at 2 s (a 1.2 s cap under-led a rider by ~5 m: closest orb 2.58 m, harness boss36 --trace) so a rider who changes pace or jumps off still breaks it (n30 leadSeconds 0.6 was the old fixed lead; the cap keeps the fan readable: it lands where he was going, not where he can never avoid).
fan.returnSpeed_why: m/s a parried orb flies back to the core (fast: the payoff reads in under a second from 15 m).

floor._why: THE FLOOR (RED, ride): the floor glows from the well out, then is lava; a rider or a player above safeY is safe. Then a punish.
floor.activeSeconds_why: Live 4 s (n29 7 s was a wait; one hold ride is up to 8 s: wallride35 safety cap).
floor.punishSeconds_why: After the lava the lantern sags, core open, 3 s (Birkhead: travel + one combo).
floor.damagePerSecond_why: Lava on the floor (n29 8/s; raised so standing in it is a real cost; nothing kills in under 0.5 s).
floor.safeY_why: Feet this high above the floor are safe (a jump's air).
floor.radius_why: The whole floor inside the 15 m apothem (hall spec zone `floor`).

sweep._why: THE PANEL SWEEP (RED, dodge): an arm points ahead of the rider; a beam sweeps the wall band back toward him; drop off or jump it. Then a punish (the arm stuck).
sweep.activeSeconds_why: The beam runs 2.4 s (110 deg/s: 264 deg, it meets any rider).
sweep.punishSeconds_why: After the sweep the arm is stuck in the wall: core open 3 s.
sweep.degPerSecond_why: 110 deg/s at 15 m = 29 m/s along the wall: faster than a rider (10.45 m/s), so it must be dodged, not outrun.
sweep.halfWidthDeg_why: The beam's half width (1.6 m at the wall).
sweep.aheadDeg_why: The beam starts 70 deg ahead of the player in his direction (n30 sweepAheadPanels 2 = 45 deg, wider: the tell must read before it arrives).
sweep.bandLow_why: The bottom edge of the beam, 1 m up: a player standing at the wall is still hit; the dodge is 3 m in from the wall (wallBand) or a double jump over the top.
sweep.bandHigh_why: ...to 7.5 m (a rider at 2-6 m is inside it; a double jump off the wall clears it).
sweep.wallBand_why: The beam reaches 3 m in from the wall (the middle of the hall is safe).
sweep.damage_why: One hit per sweep (n30 sweep 7.5 a tick, at most 45 over a burn).
sweep.beamsP2_why: THE CHANGE at 50 %: two beams, opposite each other (Boss36: one change after the stun).

camp._why: THE ANTI-CAMP SLAM (RED): aimed at the spot the player has camped on for boss36.campSeconds.
camp.tellSeconds_why: A 1 s red decal on the camped spot (n30 platformOrbTellSeconds 1).
camp.activeSeconds_why: The slam lands at once; a short recover.
camp.radius_why: The slam's radius: step 3 m aside and it misses.
camp.damage_why: A real cost (more than an orb) for staying put.

arena.facets_why: 64 flat facets (5.6 deg seams: n32 arenas32 measured a clean ride lap on 64).
arena.gapFacets_why: The entry gap: the two facets centred on +z (2.95 m wide at a 15 m apothem).
arena.trimLow_why: The cyan ride band's bottom (view; n30 laneLow).
arena.trimHigh_why: The cyan ride band's top (view; n30 laneHigh).

muzzle36._why: View only (builder F; REVIEW.md root cause 2: nails / rockets / grenades are drawn from the eye; tracers start before the kick): projectiles drawn from the muzzle and blended onto the sim path; tracers from the post-kick muzzle; the slug one line (ULTRAKILL: the hit ray from the camera, the beam drawn from gunBarrel: rea-ultrakill-combat.md section 1). Render numbers in UnityTuning.Guns36.cs.

fist36._why: View only (builder F; REVIEW.md root cause 3: the gauntlet is a 10 cm block, BlockyKit.cs:568-581): a low-poly hand and forearm with a lunge, a follow-through and a parry pose. Render numbers in UnityTuning.Guns36.cs.

text36._why: View only (builder M; REVIEW.md root cause 10: every teaching line sits at 24 px in the top slot, 54 px from the top; GG 2026-10-12: 'the tutorial text is way too high up'): the teaching lines (teach35), the lessons and a boss's teaching line move to their own slot in the lower middle (about 62 % down the screen), 32 px at 1080p on a soft plate, apart from the room name (which keeps the top slot). UI numbers in UnityTuning.Move36.cs (Hud36Teach*). Off: NIGHT35's top slot.

bossmodel36._why: View only (builder B, DECIDE36 D-3: CLAUDE.md rule 7's 'rebuilt as they are' lifted for bosses only): jointed low-poly boss bodies built in code (a hierarchy, spring bones, a pose per attack), the dusk palette, an emissive core and rim; readable as a silhouette. Render numbers in UnityTuning.Boss36.cs.

level36._why: Flow (builder L, NIGHT36.md L1, PLAN.md section 3): the campaign's level 1 becomes the from-scratch n36-foundry (levelSwap, applied after N35Levels by Curriculum25.N36Levels); levels 2-6 unchanged tonight (D-2 depth first). The level file (Tools/night/gen-n36-foundry.cjs, bash Tools/night/n36-regen.sh) marks its fight rooms arena36: true; there Game/SurvivalSim.Level36.cs runs ULTRAKILL's arena flow (the numbers below); older levels carry no arena36 room and are untouched. Off (row off, --off36 / -skygrindOff36): the campaign plays n35-foundry and no arena flow runs.
level36.switchOnDelayS_why: ULTRAKILL: enemies start appearing 1 s after the doors lock (ActivateArena.cs:107-110, 126-151; Research/2026-10-12-wave36/research/rea-ultrakill-combat.md section 4). A wave's first enemy switches on this long after the room's entry.
level36.staggerS_why: ULTRAKILL: then one more enemy every 0.1 s (ActivateArena.cs:126-151; rea-ultrakill-combat.md section 4).
level36.nextWaveS_why: ULTRAKILL: the next wave starts 1 s after the last enemy of a wave dies (ActivateNextWave.cs:31-91). Measured from the death: the campaign's own waveGap (design.n24.campaign.waveGap) runs first, the rest of this is added to the switch-on.
level36.bubbleS_why: ULTRAKILL's spawn bubble shrinks at 2 per second (SpawnEffect.cs; rea-ultrakill-combat.md section 4): a unit bubble is gone in 0.5 s. The view's bubble and light last this long (the event arena36SpawnIn carries it).
level36.lastKillSlowS_why: ULTRAKILL: after the last wave a 0.15 slow-down, then the doors unlock (ActivateNextWave.cs:68-142; rea-ultrakill-combat.md section 4). Carried by the event arena36LastKill for the Game's time layer.
level36.lastKillSlowScale_why: The world's speed during that slow-down. ULTRAKILL's TimeController scale for it was not read (not checked): 0.25 is ours (a third of design.n27.slowAim27.scale 0.75, so it reads as a different, sharper beat), to tune on Player frames.
level36.unlockStaggerS_why: ULTRAKILL: the doors unlock one every 0.1 s (ActivateNextWave.cs:68-142). The view's door lights turn back in this order (event arena36Unlock).
level36.launchReachM_why: Tools/night/n36-jobs.cjs: a lava pool must have an enemy spot or route within this many metres (lava an enemy can never be launched into is decoration). PLAN.md section 1 (heal36's ~4 m close-kill radius, the punch's reach plus a launch's carry); builder P's design.n36.launch36.reachM wins when it exists.

n37._why: NIGHT37, the boss night: every boss but THE KILN WYRM restarted from scratch as a moving fight (GG 2026-10-12 ~19:25, verbatim in Research/2026-10-12-wave37/GG-REQUEST.md: 'I want all the bosses completely overhauled and restart from scratch except the worm boss ... it should be a consistently moving ... battle ... let's not do it traditional'). Design: Research/2026-10-12-wave37/BOSSES.md; decisions: DECIDE37.md (D-2 all four tonight). Every row is off in the shared commit and turned on only when its check passes. Off (--off37 / -skygrindOff37, and every older off switch): NIGHT36's game bit for bit. A boss row's levelFrom -> levelTo swaps its level in the campaign order while the row is on (Curriculum25.N37Levels).

boss37._why: Builder K (NIGHT37.md K1; BOSSES.md shared rules 1-8): the Boss37 brain the four bosses share (Core/Boss37.cs): legs with checkpoints, the stagger meter + the CYAN window (ULTRAKILL Minos Prime's stamina), the attack budget with a forced rest and the parry refund (MinosPrime.cs:342-353, :1125), bursts then a rest (Gabriel.cs:132-142), the weighted pick with pity (Gabriel.cs:74-128), the habit reader (Minotaur.cs:294-296), the camp clock (Boss36), the anti-hide timer (GabrielBase.cs:355-363); research/uk-bosses.md. A boss's row overrides any key under its own `kit` object. Harness: `boss37 kit` prints each rule alone. Off: no Boss37 boss is built (the n36 bosses stay).
boss37.restSeconds_why: Seconds of rest after a burst, after the CYAN window and after a leg change: between Gabriel's 3 s (Standard) and 1 s (Brutal) burst cooldown (Gabriel.cs:132-142), near Boss36's restP1 1.6 s (design.n36.boss36). The player is always moving in a Boss37 fight, so the rest is a breather, not a wait.
boss37.burst_why: Attacks chained back to back before a rest: Gabriel's burst of 2 on Standard (Gabriel.cs:132-142; 3 on Violent+). BOSSES.md rule 4.
boss37.budgetCap_why: Budget points per leg (leg 1, 2, 3) before the forced rest: Minos Prime's cap 6 unenraged on Standard (MinosPrime.cs:342-353); leg 3 is the enraged leg: Sisyphus Prime's 10 enraged on Standard (SisyphusPrime.cs:365-376). Attack costs 1-3 are each boss's (MinosPrime.cs:520-740).
boss37.budgetRestSeconds_why: Seconds of the forced rest at the cap: 2 s on Standard and up (MinosPrime.cs:342-353). BOSSES.md rule 4: 'the breather where you reposition'.
boss37.parryRefund_why: Budget points a parry takes back: attackAmount -= 5 (MinosPrime.cs:1125; SisyphusPrime.cs:1181). Delta: the budget is clamped at 0 here (Minos lets it go negative), so two parries never buy a boss 10 extra attacks before its rest.
boss37.pityStep_why: The pity bonus every unpicked attack gains per pick; the picked attack's resets to 0; never the previous attack (Gabriel.cs:74-128). BOSSES.md rule 5.
boss37.stagger_why: The stagger meter's full value per leg (leg 1, 2, 3): Minos Prime's stamina 6 in phase 1 and 12 in phase 2 (BOSSES.md rule 3; DECIDE37 D-5); leg 2 between them. A boss's right move calls Stagger(amount) with its own amounts (a parry 2-3, a pierce 2 ...).
boss37.windowSeconds_why: The CYAN window's length (the core takes full damage): BOSSES.md rule 3 '2-3 s'; THE WICK's and THE STAG's cards say 2.5 s.
boss37.chipScale_why: The damage share outside the window and outside the boss's right move: BOSSES.md 'anything from a ledge does 10 %' (THE WICK), 'Guns do 10 %' (THE STAG). Boss37Brain.Scale(rightMove).
boss37.autoLegs_why: The legs follow the bar (legAt). A boss whose legs are places (a lap, a tower pair) sets kit.autoLegs false and calls NextLeg() itself.
boss37.legAt_why: The bar's fraction at which leg 1 and leg 2 end: three equal legs (BOSSES.md rule 1: 'split into 3 legs'; ULTRAKILL Leviathan: the arena changes at each third).
boss37.legChangeSeconds_why: Seconds of the leg change (the arena changes, no attacks, no damage): as long as the longest wind-up (BOSSES.md rule 7: 1.0-1.5 s) so the change reads as one beat.
boss37.restartRestSeconds_why: Seconds the boss rests after RestartLeg (a fall / a death puts the player at the leg's checkpoint, DECIDE37 D-6): one rest (restSeconds) to get moving before the next tell.
boss37.habitSeconds_why: Seconds for the habit bias to cross from 1 (air / walls) to 0 (ground) or back: BOSSES.md rule 5 '~8 s' (Minotaur.cs:294-296 drifts over 20 s; ours is a shorter fight).
boss37.habitGain_why: A ground-tagged attack weighs 1 + habitGain x (1 - airBias), an air-tagged one 1 + habitGain x airBias: at full habit the denying attack is 3x as likely as an untagged one of the same weight. Ours (Minotaur picks by a roll against the bias, Minotaur.cs:399-410).
boss37.habitSnap_why: After a habit attack the bias snaps to the other extreme (Minotaur.cs:399-410), so the boss doesn't deny the same space twice running.
boss37.campSeconds_why: Seconds grounded inside campRadius before the next pick is the boss's camp attack: THE WICK's plate slam 'on a ledge > 3 s', THE CROWN's 'one platform > 3 s' (BOSSES.md). Boss36 used 6 s (V2.cs:708-731); a moving fight answers sooner.
boss37.campRadius_why: Metres: staying within 4 m of one spot counts as camping (design.n36.boss36.campRadius); a wall ride or leaving the circle restarts the clock.
boss37.hideSeconds_why: Seconds on the hide timer before the boss repositions onto the player (boss37Hide): GabrielBase.cs:355-363 teleports at 3 s. BOSSES.md rule 6.
boss37.hideFill_why: The hide timer fills 1 per second hidden (GabrielBase.cs:355-363).
boss37.hideDrain_why: The hide timer drains 2 per second seen (GabrielBase.cs:355-363).
boss37.hideReach_why: Metres: farther than this from the boss counts as hiding (GabrielBase.cs:355-363: more than 20 m away).
boss37.hideBelow_why: Metres: more than this below the boss counts as hiding (GabrielBase.cs:355-363: more than 15 m below).

wick37._why: Builder W (NIGHT37.md W1; BOSSES.md 'L1 THE WICK'): level 1's boss replaced by THE WICK, a climb up a 40 m furnace stack away from rising slag; it is only hurt from the walls. Builder W adds its numbers with their _why.

stack._why: THE STACK (Research/2026-10-12-wave37/BOSSES.md 'L1 THE WICK'; Core/Enemies/Wick37Stack.cs builds it as one triangle layer at the room row's wick37.centre). Distances measured on the real Mover by the harness `wick37 climb` (Tools/SimHarness/Harness.N37.Wick.cs).
stack.radius_why: Research/2026-10-12-wave37/BOSSES.md 'L1 THE WICK': 'shaft: round, inner radius 9 m'.
stack.facets_why: The shaft and the cap ring as 64 flat facets: the Lantern / Crown rings' count (a clean ride lap measured on 64, BOSSES.md 'What the engine can do today').
stack.gapFacets_why: The entry gap's facets (5 x 0.88 m = 4.4 m): wider than the level's 4 m door (Tools/night/n36-lib.cjs Level.room) so the tunnel meets it.
stack.gapHeight_why: The entry gap's and tunnel's height: the level's door height (n36-lib.cjs: min(4.5, ...)).
stack.tunnelLength_why: The tunnel from the shaft's gap out to the room's south wall (the room is 2 x capRadius + 2 m square: 14 - 9 m + 0.5 m into the door).
stack.perTurn_why: LOGGED (Research/2026-10-12-wave37/BOSSES.md 'L1 THE WICK' says 3 per turn): a jump-off leaves a panel 8 m/s straight out (design.n35.wallride35.outSpeed) plus the ride's ~12.4 m/s along it, a chord of the shaft that meets the panels' circle again about 66 degrees further round; at 4 per turn the next panel's face spans 63-117 degrees from the last one's centre, at 3 per turn (120 degrees) the chord lands short of it. Measured: harness `wick37 climb`.
stack.rise_why: LOGGED (BOSSES.md: 2-2.5 m higher): 2.8 (round 2b: a chained climb speeds up 2 m/s a jump-off to the 20 m/s chain cap, and at 20 m/s the leap loses 0.94 m against 3.2 a hop: the chain sank and fell; 2.8 keeps a chain alive). Round 2: 3.2. Measured on the real Mover (harness wick37 gaps, every gap from a panel's low line): at 2.6 a LEVEL jump-off (pitch 0, 6.62 m/s) still rode the next panel (a 2.8 m release window), at 3.0 still by a 1.6 m window (margin +0.12 m); at 3.2 only a leap with the look up (upHigh 9.12 m/s at 45 deg, design.n35.wallride35) does, with or without the double jump, and riding alone never (wallgrip36). The margins and windows per gap are the harness's.
stack.panelApothem_why: The ride faces stand 1 m in from the hot shaft wall (radius 9 - 1): a rider on a panel (capsule 0.35 m) is 0.65 m clear of the hot wall, so the sim tells a panel ride from a hot-wall ride by the distance from the axis.
stack.panelLength_why: Research/2026-10-12-wave37/BOSSES.md 'L1 THE WICK': 'Ride panels (cyan stripe, 8 m long, 3.5 m tall)'.
stack.panelThickness_why: Tools/night/n36-lib.cjs panel()'s default thickness (the level's other ride panels).
stack.firstBottom_why: The first panel stands on the floor: run in and ride it (the walk-in's first verb).
stack.firstAngleDeg_why: The first panel's centre angle (atan2(z, x)): the west side, seen straight ahead-left from the gap (+z, 90 deg); a rider on it rides north, the spiral climbs counter-clockwise.
stack.panelCount_why: Fifteen panels of the spiral (3 + 6 + 6 between the floor, the two ledges and the cap): with rise 2.8, ledgeOver 1.4 and the ledges, the cap lands at 38.4 m (BOSSES.md: 40 m tall).
stack.ledgeAfter_why: LOGGED (BOSSES.md: 'ledge rings at 8 m and 22 m', the leg checkpoints): measured on the real Mover (harness wick37 gaps), a floor is landed on only when the feet clear it, 1.45 m more than a ride needs to catch a panel, so a full ring at a panel's height cut the panel under it. The ledges are ARCS in the spiral's next slot after panels 2 and 8: ledge 1 at 7.0 m, ledge 2 at 22.7 m (rise 2.8).
stack.ledgeOver_why: Metres a ledge (and the cap) stands over the bottom of the panel before it. Round 2 measured (harness wick37 climb): at 2.0 a leap at the chain cap (19.4 m/s along) reaches the ledge arc 0.2 s after the jump-off, still rising, 0.4 m under its top (it hit the arc's end face); at 1.4 the feet clear it from the panel's low line with the look up. A ledge is a rest: it need not refuse a level leap.
stack.ledgeArcDeg_why: Ours: each ledge spans 80 degrees of the ring (11.7 m at 8.4 m), centred in its spiral slot: 23 degrees clear of the panels either side (their ends at +-26.6 degrees of their own slots, 90 apart).
stack.ledgeWidth_why: LOGGED (Research/2026-10-12-wave37/BOSSES.md 'L1 THE WICK': '(rest, 1.2 m wide)'): 2.6. Round 2b measured (harness wick37 climb --trace): a jump-off leaves a panel along a chord of the shaft that dips to 6.7-7.5 m from the axis, so a 1.2 m ledge (7.8-9 m) was flown over inside its edge; 2.6 m (6.4-9 m) catches the chord. The arcs stand in their own slot of the spiral, clear of the panels.
stack.ledgeThickness_why: Ours: a slab you read as a floor from below.
stack.ledgeSegments_why: Ours: each ledge arc as 8 sectors (its outer edge buried 0.4 m behind the 64-facet wall); few triangles for the layer's linear scan (BOSSES.md: keep layers small).
stack.sectionStartAbove_why: Ours: the first panel of a section stands this far over the ledge it starts from (ride it from the ledge).
stack.capRadius_why: Research/2026-10-12-wave37/BOSSES.md 'L1 THE WICK': 'THE CAP (a ring catwalk, r 9 m)': the catwalk runs from the shaft's rim (9 m) out to its ride wall at 13 m (4 m of catwalk to stand and dash on).
stack.capWallHeight_why: The cap's ring wall (one long ride panel round the full lap): tall enough that chained jump-offs (about +1.7 m each at the chain cap) don't leave the arena in a lap.

slag._why: THE SLAG (Research/2026-10-12-wave37/BOSSES.md 'L1 THE WICK': 'Rising slag: a hazard plane that rises 0.6 m/s during the Wick's attacks and stops during its rests (always 4+ m below the last ledge you reached); touching it = 30 damage and a bounce out (not death)'). Core/Enemies/Wick37Stack.cs Wick37Slag.
slag.startY_why: Ours: the surface starts just under the floor (the grate glows); the first attacks bring it over the floor.
slag.riseRate_why: Research/2026-10-12-wave37/BOSSES.md 'L1 THE WICK': 0.6 m/s while it attacks.
slag.belowLedge_why: Research/2026-10-12-wave37/BOSSES.md 'L1 THE WICK': 'always 4+ m below the last ledge you reached' (the leg's checkpoint floor; the floor's checkpoint is ledge 1's: the walk-in climb is under pressure from the start).
slag.bounceOver_why: Ours: the bounce lifts the player to the checkpoint ledge's height + 1.2 m, toward the wall (the ledge ring runs round the whole wall: he lands on it). 'a bounce out (not death)'.
slag.bounceOut_why: Round 3: the small pop (m/s up) after the slag throws the player back to the leg's checkpoint (the ledge arcs no longer ring the wall: a bounce toward it fell back in)
slag.cooldown_why: Ours: one touch per 0.8 s (the bounce is in the air by then).
slag.draftRise_why: Research/2026-10-12-wave37/BOSSES.md 'L1 THE WICK': 'Draft (no damage): ... (the slag rises 1 m)'.
slag.maxBounce_why: Ours: the bounce's up speed never passes 22 m/s (about 10 m at the game's 23.1 m/s2 rise gravity); a deeper fall is carried to the checkpoint by the leg restart instead.

kit._why: THE WICK's overrides of design.n37.boss37 (Core/Boss37.cs Boss37Params.From(cfg, "wick37")). Legs are places (the ledges, the cap): the sim calls NextLeg.
kit.autoLegs_why: Research/2026-10-12-wave37/BOSSES.md 'L1 THE WICK': the legs are the stack's places (ledge 1 / ledge 2 / the cap), not health thirds.
kit.stagger_why: Research/2026-10-12-wave37/BOSSES.md 'L1 THE WICK': 'Stagger empty (2 parries + 1 pierce)': each parried ember drains 1 (boss.parryStagger), each pierce through a gap 1 (boss.pierceStagger).

attacks._why: THE WICK's attacks (Boss37Attack.From: kind, windup / active / recover seconds, cost, weight, legs, habit). Wind-ups from BOSSES.md; costs in MinosPrime.cs's 1-3 (uk-bosses.md).

ember._why: Research/2026-10-12-wave37/BOSSES.md 'L1 THE WICK': 'Ember volley (YELLOW, 1.2 s wind-up): 3 slow globs at you. Parry one back into the cage: it cracks a plate'. Weight 1.4: the parry is the fight's key (a crack is the pierce's gap).

flare._why: Research/2026-10-12-wave37/BOSSES.md 'L1 THE WICK': 'Flare sweep (RED, 1.4 s): a ring of fire wipes the half of the shaft wall you're riding ... leap across'. Active 0.8 s: the burn.

slam._why: Research/2026-10-12-wave37/BOSSES.md 'L1 THE WICK': 'Plate slam (RED, 1.0 s, only if you're on a ledge > 3 s)': the brain's camp clock (design.n37.boss37.campSeconds 3).

dive._why: Research/2026-10-12-wave37/BOSSES.md 'L1 THE WICK': 'Leg 3 (the cap): ... It dives at you (RED) and stalls at the wall (the dive's stall = its last window)'. Recover 1.8 s = the stall (a launch punch from a dash knocks it into the shaft).

boss._why: THE WICK (Research/2026-10-12-wave37/BOSSES.md 'L1 THE WICK'): a cage of 6 iron plates round a flame core, ~4 m tall, on the shaft's centre line at the player's height + 2 m. Core/Enemies/Wick37.cs.
boss.name: THE WICK
boss.pool_why: THE LANTERN's 540 (design.n36.boss36.lantern.pool, its bot band 20 s) + 11 %: the climb paces this fight (the bar is locked per leg). Tuned on the harness band `wick37 band`.
boss.legLock_why: The bar never falls under 60 % in leg 1 or 30 % in leg 2 (the climb paces the fight: rule 1, the fight travels); leg 3 (the cap) ends it.
boss.cageR_why: Research/2026-10-12-wave37/BOSSES.md 'L1 THE WICK': '~4 m tall' cage: its plates on a 1.7 m radius (the hit sphere).
boss.coreR_why: Ours: the flame core drawn inside the cage.
boss.aboveP_why: Research/2026-10-12-wave37/BOSSES.md 'L1 THE WICK': 'floats on the centre line at your height + 2 m'.
boss.followRate_why: Ours: m/s it follows the climb on the axis (a pitched leap rises ~9 m/s at its start, ~2.2 m a hop: it keeps up, never snaps).
boss.revealSeconds_why: The walk-in reveal (it rises out of the slag): shorter than THE LANTERN's 3.5 s (design.n36.boss36.lantern.revealSeconds): the climb starts at once.
boss.riseFrom_why: Ours: it rises out of the slag under the floor.
boss.dieSeconds_why: THE LANTERN's 2.2 s + its fall into the slag.
boss.plates_why: Research/2026-10-12-wave37/BOSSES.md 'L1 THE WICK': 'a cage of 6 iron plates'.
boss.turnDegPerS_why: Ours: the cage turns to face the climber (at most 90 deg/s; a rider circles the shaft at ~78 deg/s): the plate a parried ember cracks stays on his side, so the parry -> pierce combo can be made from the next panel.
boss.crackSeconds_why: Ours: a cracked plate stays open 4 s (time for a leap and a charged shot: the KESTREL's charge).
boss.anyShotFromRide_why: LOGGED, round 3 (BOSSES.md: 'A KESTREL charged pierce fired FROM A WALL RIDE through an open gap'): any KESTREL shot from a ride through a cracked gap is the right move (full damage, the gap spent, stagger -1); a CHARGED one (>= chargedMin) drains 2. The tap-or-charge choice stays the player's; the wall ride and the gap are the rule.
boss.rideGrace_why: A shot within 0.35 s of a ride counts as fired from the wall (the leap off it): design.n36.boss36.lantern.shield.rideGraceSeconds.
boss.pierceStagger_why: Research/2026-10-12-wave37/BOSSES.md 'L1 THE WICK': '2 parries + 1 pierce' empty the meter (kit.stagger 3).

ember._why: Research/2026-10-12-wave37/BOSSES.md 'L1 THE WICK': 'Ember volley ... 3 slow globs'. The globs as THE LANTERN's orbs (design.n36.boss36.lantern.fan).
ember.homeDegPerS_why: Ours, round 3 (harness wick37 band: 27 ember volleys at a climber, 0 hits and 0 parries: a rider at 10-12 m/s round a curve outruns a 9 m/s glob led straight): each glob turns toward the climber at most 70 deg/s, slow enough to read and dodge, close enough to meet: the parry (YELLOW) happens.
ember.leadMax_why: Ours: they lead a climber by at most 1 s.
ember.parryDamage_why: lantern shield.parryDamage (60): a returned glob lands as a parry hit.

flare._why: Research/2026-10-12-wave37/BOSSES.md 'L1 THE WICK': 'Flare sweep (RED, 1.4 s): a ring of fire wipes the half of the shaft wall you're riding (the red bar shows which half)'.
flare.damage_why: lantern sweep.damage's order (one hit per flare).
flare.wallBand_why: Metres in from the wall that burn (the panels' riders and the ledges: the panels' faces stand 1 m in).
flare.below_why: Metres under THE WICK the band reaches (it floats 2 m over you).
flare.halfDeg_why: Research/2026-10-12-wave37/BOSSES.md 'L1 THE WICK': 'the half of the shaft wall' (+-90 degrees round your angle).

slam._why: Research/2026-10-12-wave37/BOSSES.md 'L1 THE WICK': 'Plate slam (RED, 1.0 s, only if you're on a ledge > 3 s): ... a plate drops on the ledge'.
slam.damage_why: Ours (between an ember and the slag's 30).
slam.radius_why: Ours: the plate's footprint on the ledge ring (campRadius 4 > 3: step off and it misses).

dive._why: Research/2026-10-12-wave37/BOSSES.md 'L1 THE WICK': 'Leg 3 (the cap): the Wick bursts out of the top and circles the cap's catwalk ... dives at you (RED) and stalls at the wall ... a launch punch from a dash knocks it into the shaft and the slag. The end.'
dive.speed_why: Ours: m/s of the dive (crosses the cap's 13 m in under a second: dodge the RED).
dive.reach_why: Ours: the dive's hit reach past the capsule.
dive.circleR_why: Ours: it circles over the shaft's rim (radius 7) while it rests.
dive.launchReach_why: The punch's reach to the stalled cage (design.n36.boss36.lantern.shield.parryReach 3).
dive.launchDamage_why: Each launch punch takes 20 % of the pool (three stalls from the 30 % lock... the last one ends it).
dive.launchGrace_why: Ours, round 3 (harness wick37 band: the stall came with THE WICK 0.2 m from a climber pinned at the wall, and a punch launched only mid-dash): a punch within 0.5 s after a dash still launches (the dash-punch as one move, ULTRAKILL's early parry buffer's spirit).
dive.finishAt_why: A launch that leaves it at or under 15 % ends it: into the slag.

boss.restartCost_why: D-6: a fall restarts the leg and costs health (20, THE LOOM's void fall's -20 in BOSSES.md).

air._why: Ours, round 2b (harness wick37 climb --trace's leap log): a chained climb gains 2 m/s per jump-off (design.n35.wallride35.exitBoost) up to the 20 m/s chain cap, and at 20 m/s a leap reaches the next panel in ~0.35 s, 0.9-1.0 m lower than at the ride's 10.4 m/s: the chain sank a panel's height every 2-3 hops and fell. Inside the shaft (under the cap, not in a dash) the hot air bleeds horizontal speed over maxSpeed, so every leap of the climb flies the same, learnable arc (the gaps harness's 10.4-12.4 m/s numbers hold on every lap). Off the stack nothing changes.
air.maxSpeed_why: The ride's floor 10.4 m/s (design.n35.wallride35: wallRide.minSpeed 8 x 1.3) + one exit boost (2 m/s): a leap off a panel keeps its boost, a chain doesn't stack it.

hotWall._why: Ours (the engine audit: any wall with |normal.y| < 0.3 is ridable, Mover.cs IsValidWall): the shaft's own wall would be a ride everywhere and chained jump-offs climb a 9 m ring (~+1.7 m a hop at the chain cap), so the spiral would not matter. The shaft wall is HOT iron (red-orange: danger, rule 8): a ride or a touch on it throws the player off (Mover.Impulse ends a ride) and burns. Only the cyan panels hold.
hotWall.reach_why: Metres (round 2: 0.25 caught leaps grazing the wall at the chain cap): a player whose capsule is within this of the shaft wall (distance from the axis > radius - capsule radius - reach) touches it.
hotWall.push_why: m/s in toward the axis (the throw-off).
hotWall.damage_why: Ours: a sting, not a punishment (the slag is the stack's real cost).

stag37._why: Builder S (NIGHT37.md S1; BOSSES.md 'L2 THE STAG'): THE STAG from scratch as a chase around a frozen canal loop (Core/Enemies/Stag37.cs on K's Boss37 brain, Core/Enemies/Stag37Arena.cs, Game/SurvivalSim.Stag37.cs): the slipstream, lane changes, catching it to punch its hind legs (the stagger), the CYAN skid and the launch punch into the canal wall (one per leg), the floes in leg 2, the head-on antler charge parried into the tunnel wall in leg 3. With the row on, Curriculum25.N37Levels swaps levelFrom for levelTo (Tools/night/gen-n37-iceline-boss.cjs: n35-iceline's rooms up to its rest, two rehearsal rooms, THE CANAL). Level 6's old Stag (plan id glacier) is untouched. Off (row off, --off37 / -skygrindOff37): the campaign plays n35-iceline and nothing here runs.
stag37.name: THE STAG
stag37.name_why: DECIDE37 D-3: THE STAG keeps its name with a new fight.

arena._why: THE CANAL (BOSSES.md 'L2 THE STAG': 'a canal loop, ~260 m, three lanes 5 m wide each, with banked turns'): built at load by Stag37Arena at the room row's stag37.centre.
arena.straight_why: BOSSES.md 'L2 THE STAG': straight A (90 m) and straight B (90 m).
arena.turnR_why: The turns' centre-line radius, picked so the loop is 2 x 90 + 2 pi 12.75 = 260.1 m (BOSSES.md 'L2 THE STAG': ~260 m).
arena.laneWidth_why: BOSSES.md 'L2 THE STAG': three lanes 5 m wide each.
arena.lanes_why: BOSSES.md 'L2 THE STAG': three skate lanes.
arena.wallHeight_why: The outer (bank) walls: taller than a jump and the 3.5 m ride panels of the n36 rooms (Tools/night/n36-lib.cjs panels 6-7 m tall), so a rider never tops out.
arena.islandHeight_why: The loop's inside: taller than any jump + wall-ride climb (wallgrip36 never lifts you), so nobody cuts the loop.
arena.turnFacets_why: Facets per half-circle turn wall (7.5 deg, 2.7 m each at the bank). Lantern36's 64-facet ring (5.6 deg) rode cleanly (BOSSES.md engine audit: curved walls work); 24 keeps the layer small (BOSSES.md 'keep each moving layer small').
arena.gapFacets_why: The entry gap at the south apex: 2 facets = 5.3 m (the 4 m door of the level's rooms fits).
arena.gapHeight_why: The gap's height = the levels' door height (n36-lib.cjs: doors at most 4.5 m).
arena.tunnelRoofY_why: The tunnel's roof: over the lane walls (2.6 m), under the bank wall's top (5 m).
arena.tunnelFrom_why: Metres along straight B (from its north end) where the tunnel starts (BOSSES.md 'L2 THE STAG': 'straight B: lane walls, a tunnel'); leg 3 turns the Stag at its south mouth.
arena.tunnelTo_why: Where the tunnel ends: 25 m of roof, the leg-3 charge's lane.
arena.laneWallHeight_why: Lane walls on straight B: ride panels (a 2.6 m face is above a standing player's 1.8 m capsule, so the Mover rides it) with gaps to change lanes.
arena.laneWallThick_why: Thin dividers (a lane stays 4.6 m of ice).
arena.laneWallRuns_why: The lane-wall runs along straight B [from, to, from, to] (metres from its north end): one in the open, one through the tunnel; the gaps (0-10, 30-50, 75-90) are where you change lanes.
arena.floeLength_why: Straight B's ice in 15 m floes per lane (6 per lane): a floe dropped in your lane is too long to jump, so you change lanes (BOSSES.md 'L2 THE STAG': 'per-lane drops').
arena.floeThick_why: A floe's slab thickness (visual and collision).
arena.floeGap_why: The cracks between floes along B (read as floes, small enough not to trip the Mover).
arena.waterY_why: The lane walls reach down to the water (visual); a fall below fallY in the canal restarts the leg (D-6).

stag37.salt_why: Mixed with the run's seed (CLAUDE.md rule 6: gameplay randomness from Mulberry32 seeded per run) for THE STAG's brain roll and its lane weave (design.n25.bosses.*.room.salt's pattern).
stag37.pool_why: THE STAG's HP. Not a sponge (GG w31-w32): three launches (launch.damage 320 each, one per leg, BOSSES.md 'three times, one per lap') take the bar past both legAt cuts (2/3, 1/3); leg 3's parry is the kill. Leg punches and chip fill the rest.
stag37.revealSeconds_why: The walk-in: the Stag stands on straight A, looks back, then bolts (walkin36's shape; Boss36 LANTERN reveal ~2.5 s, design.n36.boss36.lantern.revealSeconds).
stag37.startAhead_why: Metres of path the Stag stands ahead of the entry gap in the reveal (and ahead of the player after a leg restart): outside the 12 m slipstream so the chase starts with a gap to close.

body._why: BOSSES.md 'L2 THE STAG': 'a long-legged ice beast with a crown of antlers, body ~3 m tall, its legs readable as targets'.
body.radius_why: The torso's hit sphere radius (a 2.4 m long torso made of two spheres front and back).
body.length_why: Torso length, nose to tail (a long-legged beast: longer than tall at the withers).
body.hindBack_why: The hind legs sit this far behind the body's centre: the catch point you punch.
body.hindY_why: The hind legs' target height (a hock: about the punch's eye-line minus 0.6 m).

run._why: The path follower (BOSSES.md 'L2 THE STAG': 'faster than you on open ice but slower in your slipstream').
run.speed_why: m/s on the straights: above the player's pumped lap average 21.2 m/s and under the slipstream cap 26.5 m/s (measured: harness `stag37 speeds` (the canal's middle lane, a scripted skater)): catching it NEEDS the slipstream (the brief's check).
run.turnSpeed_why: m/s in the turns: a long-legged beast on ice slows to turn, so a player who rides or skates the turn well gains (BOSSES.md 'L2 THE STAG': the banked turns); 0.77 x speed.
run.farGap_why: Beyond this path gap the Stag looks back and runs under your own speed (farShare) until you are back in its slipstream, in its lane (the rubber band: a chase that is lost is no fight; GabrielBase.cs:355-363's anti-hide idea turned round: it comes back into reach). The lead (NIGHT37 round 3): a casual player who only sprint-glides (10.3 m/s, harness stag37 speeds) must still catch it.
run.farShare_why: x your speed it runs while it looks back (at least leashSpeed): at a sprint-glide of 10.3 m/s it runs 7.7, so you close 2.6 m/s: from 30 m back to the slipstream's 11 m in ~7 s (the lead: within ~8 s of falling behind).
run.slipShare_why: x YOUR speed it is held to while you are in its slipstream (BOSSES.md 'L2 THE STAG': 'faster than you on open ice but SLOWER in your slipstream'): a skilled skater towed to 26.5 m/s never meets the cap (it runs its 23.5); a casual one at 11-15 m/s closes 8 % of his speed (the lead, round 3: a casual player must catch it).
run.leash_why: Unused since round 3 (the look-back covers it from farGap); kept for the row's history.
run.leashSpeed_why: m/s: the slowest it runs while it looks back (a trot: the walk speed, PortExport ground.walkSpeed 8).
run.passBy_why: m/s over the player's speed the Stag runs when he has passed it (gap < -2 m): it never stays behind you; it overtakes in a few seconds and the chase resumes (capped at charge.runSpeed 30).
run.accel_why: m/s^2 the Stag speeds up (0 -> 23.5 in 1.7 s: a bolt you can see).
run.decel_why: m/s^2 it slows (a stumble or a skid reads at once).
run.attackSlow_why: x its speed while it winds up and kicks (an attack costs it ground: the breather where you close; BOSSES.md 'L2 THE STAG' rule 4's rhythm).
run.laneShift_why: m/s it drifts across to a new lane (a 5 m lane change in 1.25 s: readable, slower than your 0.25 s dash).
run.laneEvery_why: Seconds between its lane choices (Mulberry32): it weaves, so you pick your lane to stay in its slipstream.

slip._why: THE SLIPSTREAM (BOSSES.md 'L2 THE STAG': 'within 12 m behind the Stag your skating speed gains +25 %'): applied after the glide each step (Game/SurvivalSim.Stag37.cs).
slip.range_why: BOSSES.md 'L2 THE STAG': within 12 m behind it.
slip.base_why: The skating speed the +25 % is of: the pumped lap average 21.2 m/s (measured: harness `stag37 speeds` (the canal's middle lane, a scripted skater)). The draft pushes you toward base x (1 + gain) = 26.5 m/s.
slip.accel_why: m/s^2 of the draft's push while under the cap (from 21 to 26.5 in 0.6 s: it reads as a tow; more than the glide's decay 0.12 x 26.5 = 3.2 m/s^2, design.n30.glide).
slip.laneHalf_why: Metres sideways from its line that still count as behind it (its lane, 5 m wide, and a bit).
slip.habitSeconds_why: BOSSES.md 'L2 THE STAG' says 'if you sit in its slipstream > 4 s'; measured (harness stag37 band, 10 seeds): a chaser spends 2.3-6.6 s in the slipstream per fight, in bursts, so 4 s of one fight never fired. 1.8 s of the last habitWindow (6 s, under a third of it: measured, 2.5 s fired 1 kick in 10 fights) is 'most of the time in it' and fires about once a fight (the lead, NIGHT37 round 2: want ~1 per fight).
slip.habitWindow_why: The habit counts the slipstream seconds inside the last 6 s (a ring of steps), not one unbroken stretch: a chaser drifts in and out of the 12 m (harness band: 5-6 s of slipstream per fight in bursts under 4 s), and sitting in it most of the time is the habit it punishes (Minotaur.cs:294-296's habit reads a share over ~8 s, research/uk-bosses.md).

catch._why: Damage = catch it and punch a hind leg (BOSSES.md 'L2 THE STAG').
catch.minSpeed_why: m/s the player must be skating for a leg punch to count (BOSSES.md rule 2: standing still is never a damage position; the walk speed, PortExport ground.walkSpeed 8).
catch.stagger_why: BOSSES.md 'L2 THE STAG': 'punch a hind leg: a stumble (stagger -2)'.
catch.damage_why: HP a leg punch takes (full: it is the right move). Small next to a launch (320): the punch drains the stagger, the launch does the damage.
catch.cooldown_why: Seconds between two leg punches that count (the punch's own swing; one stumble per punch).
catch.reboundSeconds_why: A blow that lands on it (a leg punch, a returned chunk, a window punch) readies the PULSE GAUNTLET's next swing within this long (the level's weapon swings once per design.n27.pulse27.swingSeconds 2.5 s, as long as the CYAN window it opens: without this the window's launch never comes). The Combat's own hook (ReadyPunch34: ULTRAKILL's whip readies the punch, design.n34.combo34.whipReady).
catch.stumbleSeconds_why: It stumbles after a leg punch or a returned chunk: its speed drops to stumbleSpeed (BOSSES.md 'L2 THE STAG': 'a stumble').
catch.stumbleSpeed_why: m/s in a stumble: under the pumped 21.2 so you keep up for the next punch.

window._why: BOSSES.md 'L2 THE STAG': 'Stagger empty = it falls and skids CYAN for 2.5 s' (Boss37 windowSeconds 2.5).
window.skidSeconds_why: Seconds the fall skids to a stop (it slides on along its line, drifting to the outer wall).
window.launchReach_why: Metres from its body a punch lands in the window (the punch's reach + the body's radius).
window.launchGrace_why: A punch within this long of a dash, slide or wall ride is a LAUNCH punch (design.n36.launch36's speed verbs and its grace idea).
window.launchDamage_why: BOSSES.md 'L2 THE STAG': 'a launch punch into its side drives it into the canal wall (a burst + full damage)'. Above pool / 3 = 300: one launch ends a leg.
window.punchDamage_why: A punch in the window that is not a launch: full damage, but a fifth of the launch (the launch is the move to land).

kit._why: Builder K's Boss37 numbers overridden for THE STAG (Boss37Params.From(cfg, "stag37")).
kit.stagger_why: Two leg punches (2 each) or a punch + a returned chunk per window: a chase gives fewer catches than an arena gives hits (the band, 15-22 s for the bot). K's [6, 9, 12] is Minos Prime's 6 / 12 (research/uk-bosses.md).
kit.hideReach_why: A chase is long: the anti-hide (GabrielBase.cs:355-363) counts only a player more than 70 m from it (the rubber band handles nearer).
kit.campRadius_why: A player standing within 6 m for campSeconds is camping on ice (K's 4 m, wider for a glide's drift); the camp answer is the kick back.

attacks._why: THE STAG's attacks (BOSSES.md 'L2 THE STAG'); timings in seconds; Boss37Attack.From reads them.

shardKick._why: BOSSES.md 'L2 THE STAG': 'Shard kick (RED, 1.0 s): a spray of ice shards down one lane behind it: change lanes'.

iceChunk._why: BOSSES.md 'L2 THE STAG': 'Ice chunk (YELLOW, 1.2 s): a big chunk lobbed back at you: punch it back into the Stag'.

laneCut._why: BOSSES.md 'L2 THE STAG': 'Lane cut (RED, 1.4 s): it rakes its antlers across a lane wall, dropping a barrier: jump it or ride the wall past it'.

kickBack._why: BOSSES.md 'L2 THE STAG': 'Kick back (habit: if you sit in its slipstream > 4 s): a two-hoof kick straight behind'. Forced by slip.habitSeconds; also the camp answer. 1.0 s: the floor of BOSSES.md rule 7 (wind-ups 1.0-1.5 s); the lead, NIGHT37 round 2.

antlerCharge._why: BOSSES.md 'L2 THE STAG': 'Leg 3 finale: a YELLOW antler charge (1.5 s wind-up, the biggest parry in the game)'. Forced when it turns at the tunnel.

shard.range_why: Metres of lane behind it the shards cover (a long lane strip: changing lanes is the answer, not dropping back).
shard.damage_why: HP a shard spray takes (a husk hit's order; Lantern36's sweep 20, design.n36.boss36.lantern.sweep.damage).
shard.height_why: Shards skim the ice: a jump over the spray (feet above this) also clears it.

chunk.flight_why: Seconds the lob takes to reach where you will be (it leads your velocity): long enough to see and punch.
chunk.gravity_why: m/s^2 on the lob (an arc that reads; the game's gravity is about 2x jump.height / apex^2).
chunk.damage_why: HP the chunk takes if you don't punch it.
chunk.parryReach_why: Metres from the eye a punch meets the chunk (Lantern36's orbs: design.n36.boss36.lantern.shield.parryReach).
chunk.parryCone_why: Degrees either side of the look a punch meets it.
chunk.returnSpeed_why: m/s the punched chunk flies back (faster than the Stag's 23.5: it always lands).
chunk.parryDamage_why: HP the returned chunk takes when it lands (a parry36 hit, full).
chunk.stagger_why: BOSSES.md 'L2 THE STAG': 'punch it back into the Stag (a stagger and a stumble)': as a leg punch.
chunk.bufferSeconds_why: The parry's early buffer (ULTRAKILL Enemy.cs:2698-2842: a punch ~0.12 s early still parries; Lantern36's parryBufferSeconds).

cut.height_why: Under the jump's 1.5 m (PortExport jump.height): jump it.
cut.seconds_why: Seconds the barrier stands (a lap's worth of a lane is closed only briefly).
cut.behind_why: Metres behind its hind legs the barrier drops (across YOUR lane).

kick.range_why: Metres behind it the two hooves reach (inside the 12 m slipstream: sitting close is what it punishes).
kick.knock_why: m/s the kick throws you back (out of the slipstream).

charge.runSpeed_why: m/s it bolts to the tunnel (or the bank) at leg 3's start (to the turn, then head-on): 34 since round 3 (30 left leg 3 at 6-8 s, the band's p50 22.3 s): it reaches a turn ~60 m on inside the leg change's 1.5 s + the rest's 1.5 s; also the pass-by cap (passBy).
charge.speed_why: m/s of the charge back down your lane (a skater meets it at ~20: a 36 m/s closing speed would leave a 4 m reach 0.1 s; at 16 the meeting is readable).
charge.parryReach_why: Metres from its antlers a punch parries the charge (' + B + ': the biggest parry in the game: more reach than the chunk's 3.5).
charge.bufferSeconds_why: A punch this long before the antlers come into reach still parries (ULTRAKILL's early buffer, Enemy.cs:2698-2842, ~0.12 s; doubled for the head-on meeting).
charge.hitRadius_why: Metres from its antlers the charge hits you.
charge.damage_why: HP the charge takes if you don't parry or dodge it.
charge.crashSeconds_why: Seconds the parried Stag flies back into the tunnel wall before it falls (the kill's beat).

floes._why: Leg 2: straight B's ice breaks into floes, per lane, telegraphed RED a lane ahead (BOSSES.md 'L2 THE STAG'; Crown32's sector drop / Crumble31 pattern).
floes.every_why: Seconds between drops while you are on or near straight B in leg 2 (1.6 in round 2; 2.4 since round 3: at 1.6 the falls made leg 2 the band's tail, p90 25.9 s; one drop per ~55 m of B at 23 m/s).
floes.tell_why: Seconds a floe pulses RED before it drops (a RED wind-up, BOSSES.md rule 7: 1.0 s).
floes.down_why: Seconds a dropped floe stays down before it refreezes.
floes.ahead_why: Metres ahead of you the next floe in your lane must start for it to be picked, at the least.
floes.leadSeconds_why: And at least your speed x this far ahead: the RED pulse (tell 1.0 s) leads the drop by >= 1 s at your skating speed, so a floe never drops under a player who could not see it coming (the lead, NIGHT37 round 2: a fall must come from ignoring the warning).

stag37.fallY_why: Feet below this inside the canal = a fall into the water: the leg restarts from its checkpoint (DECIDE37 D-6).
stag37.fallCost_why: HP a fall costs (D-6: 'costs health'; design.n37.loom37's fall costs 20 on a void; water is kinder).

pacer._why: 2.9 SLIPSTREAM's pacer (gen-n37-iceline-boss.cjs room s2's pacer37 row): a cyan skater to draft and catch.
pacer.speed_why: m/s: above the pumped 21.2 (measured: harness `stag37 speeds` (the canal's middle lane, a scripted skater)), under the slipstream's 26.5: the rehearsal is the same sum as the chase.
pacer.startSpeed_why: It bolts when you cross its start line moving at least this fast (the walk speed).
pacer.waitSeconds_why: Seconds it waits at the end (or after a catch) before it resets to the start.

loom37._why: Builder O (NIGHT37.md O1; Research/2026-10-12-wave37/BOSSES.md 'L4 THE LOOM'): THE LOOM from scratch as a canyon crossing with no floor (level 4 = n37-span: n33-span's rooms s1..s7, two rehearsal rooms o1 THREAD LINE / o2 SWING ANCHOR and o3 THE CANYON, Tools/night/gen-n37-span-boss.cjs). The grapple is the footing; nails in its knees are torn by pulling away. Game/SurvivalSim.Loom37.cs, Core/Enemies/Loom37.cs, Game/Loom37View.cs. Off (row off, --off37): level 4 is n33-span and its old LOOM.
loom37.hp_why: THE LOOM's health. Damage lands in full only in the CYAN window (D-5, Boss37 Scale): three 2.5 s windows of the NAILGUN (rate 12 x 9 = 108 a second, PortExport weapons.nailgun) are about 810; leg 3's window ends in the fall whatever is left (BOSSES.md rule 3: no health sponge): a first pick, tuned on the band (bot p50 15-22 s).
loom37.fallY_why: m: feet under this height inside THE CANYON = a fall (the tower tops are at 8, the ledges at 0, the void floor at -24): the player is put back on the last anchor ledge stood on (BOSSES.md: 'fall = back to the last anchor ledge'; D-6 the leg's checkpoint).
loom37.fallCostHp_why: health a canyon fall costs (Research/2026-10-12-wave37/BOSSES.md 'L4 THE LOOM': '-20 HP').
loom37.cutDelayS_why: s: a thread anchor goes dark this long after THE LOOM passes it (its station moves north of the anchor) (Research/2026-10-12-wave37/BOSSES.md 'L4 THE LOOM': 'nodes go dark 3 s after it passes').
loom37.cutPulseS_why: s: the last part of cutDelayS the anchor pulses RED before it goes dark (Research/2026-10-12-wave37/BOSSES.md 'L4 THE LOOM': 'RED pulse first'; NIGHT36 tells: a wind-up of 1.0-1.4 s reads, BOSSES.md rule 7).
loom37.hideS_why: s on one tower (its top or its faces) before THE LOOM severs that tower's anchors (Research/2026-10-12-wave37/BOSSES.md 'L4 THE LOOM': 'Hide rule: if you stay on one tower > 4 s, it severs that tower's anchors').
loom37.tearRefill_why: a torn knee gives one grapple charge back (design.n32.grapple32 G32Give). NEW (the web has no grapple charges): MEASURED (loom37 fight --trace, 2026-10-12): with two pulls a leg (to the pair, across it) and design.n32.grapple32 recharging one charge in 4 s, the bot waited on charges ~8 s a leg (kill 30-34 s, the band wants 15-22). The damage move feeds the footing, as a kill refills the charge on other levels (killRefill).
loom37.rideRefillS_why: s of one wall ride inside a loom37 room that gives one grapple charge back (once a ride). NEW (the web has no grapple charges; design.n32.grapple32 recharges one in 4 s): BOSSES.md L4's chain is 'pull, ride, pull' over a void with no enemies to refill on kills; a ride of 0.8 s (8 m at the ride's 10.45 m/s, n35-ride-distances.json) winds the next pull. A first pick, to check on the bot's crossing.
loom37.arriveUpMax_why: m/s: a pull's arrival inside a loom37 room keeps at most this much upward speed (MEASURED, loom37 fight --trace: a pull up to an anchor 8 m above kept ~24 m/s up after the zip's release and flew 14 m over it; design.n35.grapple35 clamps only the horizontal, to arriveKeepMax 4). 3 = grapple35's arrivePop: the pull 'stops there' (GG 2026-10-11, design.n35.grapple35._why). A jump or a dash cancel before the arrival keeps its speed.
loom37.swingAmpM_why: m: the o2 SWING ANCHOR's swing east-west about its rest (the room is 28 m wide; 7 m keeps it 17.5 m from the ledge, in the 40 m reach). Ours.
loom37.swingPeriodS_why: s: one full swing of the o2 anchor (slow enough to aim at: half a period 1.6 s, one grapple flight 0.06-0.1 s). Ours.
loom37.kneeRadius_why: m: a knee's hit sphere (NIGHT32's design.n32 loom jointRadius 1.3 for the old LOOM's joints, the drawing grows with it).
loom37.nailsToTear_why: nails stuck in one knee before a pull-away tears it (the NAILGUN's nails stick: three is a short burst; Research/2026-10-12-wave37/BOSSES.md 'L4 THE LOOM': 'nail a knee joint (nails stick), then pull yourself AWAY'). Ours.
loom37.tearDistM_why: m: with nailsToTear in a knee, the player's distance from it growing past this (while pulled by the grapple, or LT's detonate) tears it. Ours (a pull covers 7 m in 0.16 s at design.n31.grapplePull.speed 44).
loom37.nailHoldS_why: s: stuck nails fall out of a knee after this long without a tear (the tear must follow the nailing). Ours.
loom37.tearStagger_why: stagger drained by one torn knee: two knees empty a leg's meter (kit.stagger 6 each leg): Research/2026-10-12-wave37/BOSSES.md 'L4 THE LOOM' 'every 2 joints torn = the leg pair goes limp; at stagger empty the spinneret opens CYAN'.
loom37.parryStagger_why: stagger drained by a spool parried or whipped back (Boss37Brain.Parried; half a tear: the parry buys time, the tear is the damage move).
loom37.stationSpeed_why: m/s THE LOOM glides to its leg's station (and onto you after the anti-hide). MEASURED (loom37 fight --trace): at 5 / 8 m/s it was still crossing the gap when the next leg began, its knees (moving grapple nodes) sat on the tower-to-tower pull line and the pilot hooked a knee over the void 3 times; 36 m/s covers a station step (36 m) inside the 1.0 s leg change (kit.legChangeSeconds); leg 2 faster (Research/2026-10-12-wave37/BOSSES.md 'L4 THE LOOM').
loom37.bodyY_why: m: THE LOOM's body height over the canyon's ledges (tower tops are at 8: the knees hang between 9 and 15, inside a pull from a tower top). Ours.

kit._why: Boss37 kit overrides (Boss37Params.From reads design.n37.loom37.kit.<key> over design.n37.boss37).
kit.stagger_why: two torn knees a leg (tearStagger 3): six knees, three legs (Research/2026-10-12-wave37/BOSSES.md 'L4 THE LOOM').
kit.autoLegs_why: the legs are places (the stations): Game/SurvivalSim.Loom37.cs calls NextLeg when a CYAN window closes.
kit.legChangeSeconds_why: MEASURED (loom37 band, 2026-10-12 22:08): 23.4 s p50 with the kit's 1.5 s leg change (two changes): the station step is a glide (stationSpeed 36 covers 36 m in 1 s), so the change is shorter. The band wants 15-22 s.
kit.windowSeconds_why: the CYAN window, a little under the kit's 2.5 s: three windows a fight (one a leg) and the NAILGUN unloads at 108 a second (PortExport weapons.nailgun rate x damage). MEASURED band 23.4 s p50 before (with legChangeSeconds 1.5).
kit.chipScale_why: MEASURED (loom37 fight, 2026-10-12 first run): at the kit's 0.1 a bot that never tore a knee killed it with THUNDERCLAP chip in 32 s (772 damage, 41 hits): the damage must be the tear and the window (BOSSES.md rule 2). 0.02: chip is a scratch.

attacks._why: THE LOOM's attacks (Boss37Attack.From): Research/2026-10-12-wave37/BOSSES.md 'L4 THE LOOM'.

lash._why: THREAD LASH (RED 1.2 s): a thread whips across the span along the player's line: be off the line (pull to another node). 30 damage on a hit.

spool._why: SPOOL SHOT (YELLOW 1.2 s): a weighted spool at the player: parry it back or whip it (Parried: refund + parryStagger). 25 damage on a hit.

web._why: WEB WALL (RED 1.4 s): a sheet between the tower pair ahead (a layer swap): the route changes, ride round the tower. Legs 2-3.

loom37.lashDamage_why: health a thread lash takes when it lands on the player (a RED hit; BOSSES.md rule 7: the dodge colour costs). Ours.
loom37.lashWidthM_why: m: the lash's half width about the line from THE LOOM to where the player was at its wind-up's end. Ours.
loom37.spoolDamage_why: health a spool takes when it hits. Ours.
loom37.spoolSpeed_why: m/s the spool flies (slow enough to parry at 20 m: 0.9 s). Ours.
loom37.lashLength_why: m: how far the lash's line reaches past the body along its aim (the canyon is 120 m: it covers the span ahead). Ours.
loom37.spoolRadius_why: m: the spool's hit radius (with the player's 0.6 m chest). Ours.
loom37.parryReach_why: m: a punch meets a spool this close (NIGHT36 Lantern36's parryReach, design.n36.boss36).
loom37.parryConeDeg_why: deg: the punch's cone for a spool (as NIGHT36's orbs).
loom37.parryReturnMul_why: a parried spool flies home at spoolSpeed x this (it reads as sent back harder). Ours.
loom37.hideLeg2Scale_why: legs 2-3 sever a tower after hideS x this (Research/2026-10-12-wave37/BOSSES.md 'L4 THE LOOM': 'leg 2: it moves faster and cuts more threads'). Ours.
loom37.revealS_why: s of the walk-in reveal before its first attack (rule 1, walkin36; the player stands on the start ledge and sees the canyon).
loom37.dieS_why: s of the fall into the canyon before the room clears.
loom37.kneeSpanX_why: m: the knees' distance east / west of the body: over the gaps between the towers' inner faces (the towers stand at 9-14 m off the centre line), so a knee is 5-8 m from a tower top: nail it from the ledge, pull away to the next anchor.
loom37.kneeDropY_why: m: the knees hang this far under the body (bodyY 20 -> knees at 14: 6 m over the tower tops at 8).
loom37.kneeSpreadZ_why: m between the three knee pairs along the canyon (pair 1 south, toward the player; pair 3 north).
loom37.footSpanX_why: m: the feet grip the canyon walls (22 m off the centre line).
loom37.footDropY_why: m: the feet's height under the body.
loom37.bobM_why: m: the knees bob up and down (moving nodes: the aim must follow).
loom37.bodyHalfW_why: m: the body's hit radius (the spinneret is under it).
loom37.bodyHalfH_why: m: the body's half height (the spinneret hangs under it).
loom37.spinneretDamageScale_why: the CYAN window's damage scale on the spinneret (Boss37 Scale gives 1 in the window).

crown37._why: Builder C (NIGHT37.md C1; BOSSES.md 'L5 THE CROWN'): THE CROWN from scratch as a descent of a falling spire (level 5's n37-spire: Tools/night/gen-n37-spire-boss.cjs). The fight: the summit shatters, you drop onto orbiting ring platforms (leg 1), down the gallery's broken spiral (leg 2) to the plaza (leg 3); the Crown (a ring of 8 gems) is hurt only by a jump-dash THROUGH its ring (a pass: gems break) or in the CYAN window its stagger break opens; leg 3 ends with a THUNDERCLAP slug or a KESTREL charge through its centre. Core/Enemies/Crown37.cs on K's Boss37 brain, Core/Orbit37.cs (the pieces), Game/SurvivalSim.Crown37.cs. Off: n33-spire and THE CROWN of NIGHT32.
crown37.name: THE CROWN
crown37.name_why: D-3: THE CROWN keeps its name with a new fight.

pieces.orbitSpeed_why: m/s along the ring (a 13 m ring turns in 23 s): Devices33's platform moves 3 m/s (design.n33.devices33.platform.speed); a little faster so the rings read as moving at 30 m. The carry is exact at any speed (the harness prints the carry error).
pieces.rideMargin_why: as design.n33.devices33.platform.rideMargin (the capsule's overhang past the edge still rides).
pieces.rideHeight_why: as design.n33.devices33.platform.rideHeight (grounded feet sit on the top within the Mover's skin).
pieces.fallDelay_why: NIGHT37.md / builder C's brief: the rehearsal stones drop 2 s after you land on them.
pieces.fallReturn_why: s a dropped rehearsal stone stays down (a retry after the stair's climb finds it back). Ours.
pieces.galleryReturn_why: s a gallery slab the beam cut stays down: the spiral is never cut off for long (BOSSES.md: 'pick another'). Ours.
pieces.orbitReturn_why: s an orbit platform dropped by the habit rule stays down. Ours.
pieces.dropSeconds_why: the view: a dropped piece falls away this long before it hides (no collider meanwhile). Render-side, kept here so the event carries it. Ours.
pieces.shatterTell_why: s the summit shakes RED before it shatters (BOSSES.md rule 7: a wind-up of 1.0-1.5 s).

crown.gems_why: BOSSES.md: a ring of 8 gem-set blades; 8 gems.
crown.gemHp_why: hp per gem: the bar is gems x gemHp. A pass breaks whole gems; in the CYAN window every hit counts toward the next gem. Ours.
crown.legGemsLeft_why: gems left when leg 2 (the gallery) and leg 3 (the plaza) start: BOSSES.md 'Leg 3 (the plaza) ... last 2 gems'; 3 + 3 + 2.
crown.passRadius_why: m from the ring's centre a body point may cross its plane and count as a pass (inside the blades' 3 m ring). Ours.
crown.lockRadius_why: m: within this the ring's facing locks (it stops turning to face you), so a pass is a straight line through a still plane. Ours.
crown.spinRate_why: rad/s the blade ring spins (the view); 0 in the CYAN window (BOSSES.md: 'the ring stops spinning CYAN').
crown.moveSpeed_why: m/s the Crown moves to its hover point (it keeps up with a running player, 8 m/s walk, never with a dash). Ours.
crown.hoverDistance_why: m from the player (flat) the Crown hovers on the line toward the piece it offers (or along the spire's turn when none): the jump-dash covers it in 0.2 s (24 m/s: config dash.speed), straight through. Ours.
crown.passAbove_why: m over the player's chest it hovers: the jump-dash's rise 0.2 s after take-off (v0 x dashJump.v0Mult 6.67 m/s under half gravity: ~1.1 m; the real sim's apex 1.85 m, Harness crown37 jumps). Ours.
crown.targetMin_why: m (flat) the nearest piece the Crown offers as the landing past it: a jump-dash flies 21 m on the flat (Harness crown37 jumps); air steering (air.accel) shortens it to about this. Ours.
crown.targetMax_why: m (flat) the farthest piece it offers (the jump-dash's flat reach 21 m plus the drop's airtime). Ours.
crown.launchLead_why: s from the moment the Crown sets its line to the jump-dash leaving the piece (the dash, then the jump): the line leads a moving piece by its flight (flat metres / config dash.speed) plus this. Ours.
crown.openers_why: each leg opens with these attacks, forced in order (Boss37Brain.Force) from its first rest; the Crown offers no line (no landing past its ring) until the last one's wind-up starts (the cut shows which piece is gone): every leg meets a cut of the piece you head for (a re-route) and a blade ring to dodge (the lead, round 3: the bot met almost no attack; pressure, never health: GG w31-w32). Ours.
crown.passSpeed_why: m/s of flat speed a pass needs (a jump-dash flies at 24, a run jump at 8: config dash.speed, ground.walkSpeed): the pass is the jump-dash's (BOSSES.md 'jump-dash THROUGH the ring'). Ours.
crown.passGems_why: gems a pass breaks without the TORCH. BOSSES.md: the gems take damage only at close range.
crown.torchGems_why: gems a pass breaks with the TORCH burning (fire held with the TORCH in hand within torchWindow of the pass): BOSSES.md '2 per pass at most'.
crown.torchWindow_why: s around the pass the TORCH counts as burning the gems passed. Ours.
crown.grantTorch_why: level 5 earns the TORCH at its END (design.n31.unlocks n33-spire earns torch); the Crown's damage rule needs it in the fight (BOSSES.md: 'the TORCH earned here burns at close range'): the spire's walk-in hands it over (with design.adds.b5 on). Ours.
crown.passStagger_why: stagger a pass drains (the right move); stagger [4, 4, 4] (kit) = two passes open the CYAN window.
crown.parryStagger_why: stagger a parried gem shard drains, and its socket shatters (a gem): BOSSES.md 'parry it back to shatter a gem socket = Stagger'.
crown.finisherMin_why: leg 3's finisher: a KESTREL charge (revolver >= 60) or a THUNDERCLAP slug (shotgun >= 300) through the ring's centre, NIGHT32's thresholds (design.n32.boss5.kit.chargeMin / slugMin).
crown.fallDamage_why: BOSSES.md L5: 'A fall = back to the leg's checkpoint platform (-20 HP)'; D-6.
crown.revealSeconds_why: the walk-in reveal: the Crown rises over the summit (walkin36's shape: a few seconds of no damage). Ours.
crown.habitStandSeconds_why: BOSSES.md: 'if you stay on one platform > 3 s, the platform drops' (never a checkpoint).
crown.habitTellSeconds_why: s the stood-on platform tells RED before it drops (BOSSES.md rule 7).
crown.airborneSeconds_why: BOSSES.md: 'if you stay airborne > 6 s, it fires low' (the lowFire attack is forced).
crown.landY_why: m over the plaza the Crown hovers in leg 3 (it 'lands': its ring at chest height, a jump-dash pass on the flat). Ours.

meter.holdRefill_why: in a flight38 room the bar never refills by itself (design.stamina.refill's 0.5 / s would give a second dash 0.4 s after a spend): only a pad fills it, so each gap gets one jump-dash.
meter.slack_why: bar over the jump-dash's cost a pad holds: a sprint drains design.stamina.sprint.drain 0.4 / s on the takeoff step before the dash, and a dash-jump needs the whole dashJumpExtra left after the boost (harness spire38 gates: without it the jump inside the dash fell back to a plain jump). meter.oneDash_why: in a flight38 room, once the first dash since the pad has ended (its jump-dash or its run-out) the meter is spent: the bar to 0 and the double jump gone until a pad or the ground outside. juice38._why: View row (builder H, PLAN.md section 4): a boss entrance = hit-stop + a shake (the bigger replaces, decays 3/s) + a full-screen flicker + the card; big boss moves shake and flicker; damage = a full-screen static / RGB-split burst for the i-frame time scaled by the hit.
